```{r anonymize-codes, include=FALSE}
# anonymize OPO and center codes for privacy (random mapping, same seed = same mapping)

set.seed(42)

# get unique OPOs, map merged OPOs to their current code first
all_opo_codes <- final_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_clean = case_when(
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
      TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE_clean)) %>%
  pull(OPO_CTR_CODE_clean) %>%
  unique()

# unique centers
all_center_codes <- final_cohort %>%
  filter(!is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE)) %>%
  pull(LISTING_CTR_CODE) %>%
  unique()

# random order -> OPO 1, OPO 2, ...
opo_anon_mapping <- tibble(
  OPO_CTR_CODE_real = all_opo_codes
) %>%
  mutate(
    random_order = sample(n()),
    OPO_anon = paste0("OPO ", random_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(random_order) %>%
  select(OPO_CTR_CODE_real, OPO_anon)

# same for centers
center_anon_mapping <- tibble(
  LISTING_CTR_CODE_real = all_center_codes
) %>%
  mutate(
    random_order = sample(n()),
    Center_anon = paste0("Center ", random_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(random_order) %>%
  select(LISTING_CTR_CODE_real, Center_anon)

# save mapping (private - don't share)
private_key <- list(
  opo_mapping = opo_anon_mapping,
  center_mapping = center_anon_mapping,
  created_date = Sys.time(),
  seed_used = 42
)
saveRDS(private_key, here("data_processed", "PRIVATE_KEY_anon_mapping.rds"))

# csv copies for quick lookup
write_csv(opo_anon_mapping, here("data_processed", "PRIVATE_KEY_opo_mapping.csv"))
write_csv(center_anon_mapping, here("data_processed", "PRIVATE_KEY_center_mapping.csv"))

# helpers to apply mapping
anonymize_opo <- function(code) {
  if (is.na(code)) return(NA_character_)
  # mergers -> current code
  code_clean <- case_when(
    code == "00527" ~ "11036",
    code == "05239" ~ "14353",
    code == "00093" ~ "19282",
    TRUE ~ code
  )
  match_idx <- match(code_clean, opo_anon_mapping$OPO_CTR_CODE_real)
  if (is.na(match_idx)) return(paste0("OPO_", code))  # Fallback

  return(opo_anon_mapping$OPO_anon[match_idx])
}

anonymize_center <- function(code) {
  if (is.na(code)) return(NA_character_)
  match_idx <- match(code, center_anon_mapping$LISTING_CTR_CODE_real)
  if (is.na(match_idx)) return(paste0("Center_", code))  # Fallback
  return(center_anon_mapping$Center_anon[match_idx])
}

# vectorized for use in mutate
anonymize_opo_vec <- Vectorize(anonymize_opo)
anonymize_center_vec <- Vectorize(anonymize_center)

cat("Created anonymous mappings:\n")
cat("- OPOs:", nrow(opo_anon_mapping), "unique codes -> OPO 1 to OPO", nrow(opo_anon_mapping), "\n")
cat("- Centers:", nrow(center_anon_mapping), "unique codes -> Center 1 to Center", nrow(center_anon_mapping), "\n")
cat("\nPrivate key files saved to data_processed/ (DO NOT SHARE):\n")
cat("- PRIVATE_KEY_anon_mapping.rds\n")
cat("- PRIVATE_KEY_opo_mapping.csv\n")
cat("- PRIVATE_KEY_center_mapping.csv\n")
```

```{r global-theme, include=FALSE}
# journal theme: Helvetica, no grid, black axes, bold labels

# colors: blue in-sequence, orange AOOS (colorblind ok, no red/green)
GLOBAL_SEQUENTIAL_COLOR <- "#00468B"  # blue
GLOBAL_AOOS_COLOR <- "#FF8C00"        # orange
GLOBAL_SEQUENCE_COLORS <- c(
  "Sequential" = GLOBAL_SEQUENTIAL_COLOR,
  "AOOS (out-of-sequence)" = GLOBAL_AOOS_COLOR
)

theme_gastro <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", family = "Helvetica"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", family = "Helvetica", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.text = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", family = "Helvetica")
    )
}

theme_set(theme_gastro())

# P values: capital P, italic, no leading zero
format_pvalue <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return(NA_character_)
  if (p < 0.001) return("P < .001")
  if (p < 0.01) return("P < .01")
  if (p < 0.05) return("P < .05")
  return(paste0("P = ", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p))))
}
```

# Main Figures

## Table 1: Baseline Characteristics

```{r timing-cohort-prep, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# timing_cohort = plausible timing; used for Table 1 and all survival
n_before_timing <- nrow(final_cohort)

# placement_time_hours first
timing_cohort_temp <- final_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    placement_time_hours = case_when(
      is.na(earliest_init) ~ NA_real_,
      is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(difftime(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx, earliest_init, units = "hours"))
    )
  )

# exclusion counts
n_excl_no_final_response <- sum(is.na(timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx))
n_excl_final_after_tx <- sum(!is.na(timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & 
                              as.Date(timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) > timing_cohort_temp$TX_DATE)
n_excl_no_placement_time <- sum(!is.na(timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & 
                                as.Date(timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= timing_cohort_temp$TX_DATE & 
                                is.na(timing_cohort_temp$placement_time_hours))
n_excl_no_clamp_timing <- sum(!is.na(timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & 
                              as.Date(timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= timing_cohort_temp$TX_DATE & 
                              !is.na(timing_cohort_temp$placement_time_hours) & 
                              is.na(timing_cohort_temp$diff_final_clamp))
n_excl_earliest_after_final <- sum(!is.na(timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & 
                                  as.Date(timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= timing_cohort_temp$TX_DATE & 
                                  !is.na(timing_cohort_temp$placement_time_hours) & 
                                  !is.na(timing_cohort_temp$diff_final_clamp) & 
                                  !is.na(timing_cohort_temp$earliest_init) & 
                                  timing_cohort_temp$earliest_init > timing_cohort_temp$FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx)

# apply filters, keep all 3 groups (<50, ≥50, AOOS)
timing_cohort <- timing_cohort_temp %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx),
    as.Date(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= TX_DATE,
    !is.na(placement_time_hours),
    !is.na(diff_final_clamp),
    earliest_init <= FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    seq_flag = factor(seq_flag, levels = c("<50 sequence", "≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)"))
  )

# diagnostic printout
cat("### Timing Cohort Exclusions\n\n")
cat("**Starting N (final_cohort):** ", format(n_before_timing, big.mark=","), "\n\n", sep="")
cat("- Excluded - Missing FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx: ", format(n_excl_no_final_response, big.mark=","), "\n", sep="")
cat("- Excluded - Final response after TX_DATE: ", format(n_excl_final_after_tx, big.mark=","), "\n", sep="")
cat("- Excluded - Missing placement_time_hours: ", format(n_excl_no_placement_time, big.mark=","), "\n", sep="")
cat("- Excluded - Missing diff_final_clamp: ", format(n_excl_no_clamp_timing, big.mark=","), "\n", sep="")
cat("- Excluded - earliest_init > FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx: ", format(n_excl_earliest_after_final, big.mark=","), "\n\n", sep="")
cat("**Final N in timing_cohort:** ", format(nrow(timing_cohort), big.mark=","), "\n\n", sep="")
cat("**Total excluded:** ", format(n_before_timing - nrow(timing_cohort), big.mark=","), "\n\n", sep="")
```

```{r table1-data-prep}
timing_cohort <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    donation_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MACRO_FAT_CAT = {
      v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor))
      case_when(
        is.na(v) ~ NA_character_,
        v == 0 ~ "0%",
        v > 0 & v < 30 ~ "1-29%",
        v >= 30 & v < 60 ~ "30-59%",
        v >= 60 ~ "≥60%"
      ) %>% factor(levels = c("0%", "1-29%", "30-59%", "≥60%"))
    },
    # cold ischemia categories
    COLD_ISCH_cat = case_when(
      is.na(COLD_ISCH_num) ~ NA_character_,
      COLD_ISCH_num < 8 ~ "<8 hours",
      COLD_ISCH_num >= 8 ~ "≥8 hours",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("<8 hours", "≥8 hours")),
    # machine perfusion Yes/No for table
    LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_original_display = case_when(
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_original == "Y" ~ "Yes",
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_original == "N" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Yes", "No"))
  )
```

```{r table1}
tbl1 <- timing_cohort %>%
  select(
    seq_flag,
    AGE, MELD_PELD_ADJ, GENDER,
    AGE_DON_donor, donation_type, BMI_DON_CALC_donor,
    MACRO_FAT_CAT, max_BILIRUBIN, max_SGOT, max_SGPT,
    DRI, DSRI,
    COLD_ISCH_cat, DISTANCE,
    LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_original_display, LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_FDA_era
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = seq_flag,
    label = list(
      AGE ~ "Recipient age (years)",
      MELD_PELD_ADJ ~ "Recipient MELD/PELD",
      GENDER ~ "Recipient gender",
      AGE_DON_donor ~ "Donor age (years)",
      donation_type ~ "Donation type",
      BMI_DON_CALC_donor ~ "Donor BMI (kg/m²)",
      MACRO_FAT_CAT ~ "Donor macrosteatosis",
      max_BILIRUBIN ~ "Donor maximum bilirubin (mg/dL)",
      max_SGOT ~ "Donor maximum AST (U/L)",
      max_SGPT ~ "Donor maximum ALT (U/L)",
      DRI ~ "Donor Risk Index (DRI)",
      DSRI ~ "Discard Risk Index (DSRI)",
      COLD_ISCH_cat ~ "Cold ischemia time",
      DISTANCE ~ "Distance (nautical miles)",
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_original_display ~ "Machine perfusion (OPTN coded)",
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_FDA_era ~ "Machine perfusion (extrapolated)"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 1,
      DRI ~ 2,
      DSRI ~ 2
    ),
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  add_p(
    test = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "kruskal.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test"
    )
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Baseline Characteristics by Sequence Group**") %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Characteristic**")

tbl1
```

```{r table1-save, include=FALSE}
# Table 1 -> PNG for Word (gt -> HTML -> webshot; tryCatch in case Chromote times out)
tbl1_gt <- tbl1 %>% as_gt()

html_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
gt::gtsave(tbl1_gt, filename = html_file)
on.exit(unlink(html_file), add = TRUE)
png_file <- "figures/main/Table1_Baseline_Characteristics.png"
tryCatch({
  webshot2::webshot(
    url = paste0("file://", normalizePath(html_file)),
    file = png_file,
    vwidth = 1000, vheight = 1600, zoom = 2, delay = 1
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("Table1 PNG save failed (e.g. Chromote timeout). ", conditionMessage(e))
})
```

**Table 1. Baseline characteristics and demographics of livers allocated at sequence < 50, sequence ≥ 50, and out-of-sequence (AOOS) allocations.** This represents the cohort included after data-set joining and application of exclusion criteria. Variables described include donor, recipient and logistical characteristics. Machine perfusion (OPTN coded) reflects the value as directly recorded in OPTN data fields. Distance is measured in nautical miles from donor hospital to transplant center. Extrapolated machine perfusion includes cases with recorded machine perfusion (LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION='Y') or cold ischemia time \>12 hours in transplants occurring after FDA approval date of the first of Transmedics and Organox (September 29, 2021), as per the extrapolation rule described above.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Figure 1: Refusal Patterns and Placement Timing

```{r fig2-panel-a-data-prep}
# timing_cohort from chunk above

# exclusion breakdown for timing_cohort
timing_exclusions <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    allocation_type = if_else(is_open_offer, "AOOS", "Sequential"),
    placement_time_hours = case_when(
      is.na(earliest_init) ~ NA_real_,
      is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(difftime(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx, earliest_init, units = "hours"))
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(allocation_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_start = n(),
    n_after_has_final_response = sum(!is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx)),
    n_excluded_no_final_response = n_start - n_after_has_final_response,
    n_after_final_before_tx = sum(!is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & as.Date(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= TX_DATE),
    n_excluded_final_after_tx = n_after_has_final_response - n_after_final_before_tx,
    n_after_has_placement_time = sum(!is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & as.Date(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= TX_DATE & !is.na(placement_time_hours)),
    n_excluded_no_placement_time = n_after_final_before_tx - n_after_has_placement_time,
    n_after_has_clamp_timing = sum(!is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & as.Date(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= TX_DATE & !is.na(placement_time_hours) & !is.na(diff_final_clamp)),
    n_excluded_no_clamp_timing = n_after_has_placement_time - n_after_has_clamp_timing,
    n_final = sum(!is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & as.Date(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= TX_DATE & !is.na(placement_time_hours) & !is.na(diff_final_clamp) & earliest_init <= FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx),
    n_excluded_earliest_after_final = n_after_has_clamp_timing - n_final,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

timing_summary <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    sequence_bin = case_when(
      seq_flag == "AOOS (out-of-sequence)" ~ "AOOS",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 1 ~ "1",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 2 ~ "2",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 3 ~ "3",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 4 ~ "4",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 5 ~ "5",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 6 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 10 ~ "6-10",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 11 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 20 ~ "11-20",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 21 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 30 ~ "21-30",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 31 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 50 ~ "31-50",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 51 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 100 ~ "51-100",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 101 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 500 ~ "101-500",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx > 500 ~ "500+",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(sequence_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    placement_time_median = median(placement_time_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    clamp_timing_median = median(diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

seq_order <- c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6-10", "11-20", "21-30", 
               "31-50", "51-100", "101-500", "500+", "AOOS")

timing_summary <- timing_summary %>%
  mutate(sequence_bin = factor(sequence_bin, levels = seq_order)) %>%
  arrange(sequence_bin)

y1_min <- min(timing_summary$placement_time_median, na.rm = TRUE)
y1_max <- max(timing_summary$placement_time_median, na.rm = TRUE)
y2_min <- min(timing_summary$clamp_timing_median, na.rm = TRUE)
y2_max <- max(timing_summary$clamp_timing_median, na.rm = TRUE)

scale_factor <- (y1_max - y1_min) / (y2_max - y2_min)
to_primary <- function(y) (y - y2_min) * scale_factor + y1_min
to_secondary <- function(y) (y - y1_min) / scale_factor + y2_min

plot_data <- timing_summary %>%
  mutate(
    clamp_on_primary = to_primary(clamp_timing_median),
    is_aoos = sequence_bin == "AOOS"
  )
```

```{r fig2-panel-b-data-prep}
  ) %>%

  select(allocation_type,

      metric == "median_distinct_refusals" ~ "Single patient refusals",

      metric == "median_recipients_bundled" ~ "Number of patients in multi-refusals",
      TRUE ~ metric
    ),
    metric_clean = factor(metric_clean, levels = c(
      "Number of patients in multi-refusals",
      "Multi-patient refusal events",
      "Single patient refusals",
      "Unique centers contacted"
    ))
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = allocation_type, values_from = value) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Sequential, AOOS), names_to = "allocation_type", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    allocation_type = factor(allocation_type, levels = c("Sequential", "AOOS"))
  )
```

**Figure 1. Refusal patterns and placement timing by allocation type.** (A) Refusal patterns comparing median counts per donor-run between In-Sequence and AOOS allocation types. Horizontal bars show: 1) unique centers contacted until acceptance (number of distinct centers contacted, including the accepting center), 2) single patient refusals (count of refusals where a center rejected an organ for one patient), 3) multi-patient refusal events (count of times per donor-run a center performed a multi-refusal, declining multiple patients simultaneously), and 4) number of patients in multi-refusals (total distinct patients declined in multi-refusal decisions per donor-run). (B) Dual-axis line plot showing median placement time (solid line, left axis; hours from initial offer to final acceptance) and median timing of final acceptance relative to cross-clamp (dashed line, right axis; hours relative to cross-clamp) across sequence bins. AOOS data points are highlighted with star markers.

```{r fig3-data-prep}
final_plot_data <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    donation_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(donation_type), !is.na(seq_flag))

# 3 groups: two blues in-sequence, orange AOOS
SEQUENCE_COLORS_3GROUP_FIG2 <- c(
  "<50 sequence" = "#0066CC",
  "≥50 sequence" = "#00468B",
  "AOOS (out-of-sequence)" = "#FF8C00"
)
sequence_colors <- SEQUENCE_COLORS_3GROUP_FIG2

# medians for caption
box_medians <- final_plot_data %>%
  group_by(donation_type, seq_flag) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(diff_final_clamp, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(diff_final_clamp, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

make_cumulative_plot <- function(data, donor_type_filter, plot_label) {
  plot_data <- data %>% filter(donation_type == donor_type_filter)
  max_val <- max(plot_data$diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = diff_final_clamp, color = seq_flag)) +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", 
               linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-50, max_val)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sequence_colors, name = "Sequence Group") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), 
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_label,
      x = "Hours from Cross-Clamp",
      y = "Cumulative Proportion of Acceptance"
    ) +
    theme_gastro(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Helvetica", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Helvetica"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Helvetica"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.05, label = "Cross-clamp", 
             angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, 
             fontface = "bold", color = "black", family = "Helvetica")
}

make_boxplot <- function(data, plot_label) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = donation_type, y = diff_final_clamp, fill = seq_flag)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", 
               alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_boxplot(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
      alpha = 0.9, 
      outlier.alpha = 0.5, 
      outlier.size = 1.5, 
      linewidth = 0.8,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sequence_colors, name = "Sequence Group") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-50, max(data$diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE))) +
    labs(
      title = plot_label,
      x = "Donation Type",
      y = "Timing of Acceptance (hours from cross-clamp)"
    ) +
    theme_gastro(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Helvetica", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Helvetica"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Helvetica"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.42, y = 2, label = "Cross-clamp", 
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", 
             color = "black", family = "Helvetica")
}

make_proportion_plot <- function(data) {
  prop_data <- data %>%
    group_by(donation_type, seq_flag) %>%
    summarise(
      n_post = sum(diff_final_clamp > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      total = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      prop = (n_post / total) * 100,
      label = paste0(n_post, "/", total, "\n(", round(prop, 1), "%)")
    )
  
  ggplot(prop_data, aes(x = donation_type, y = prop, fill = seq_flag)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label), 
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
      vjust = -0.3, 
      size = 3.5, 
      fontface = "bold",
      family = "Helvetica"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sequence_colors, name = "Sequence Group") +
    labs(
      title = "D",
      x = "Donation Type",
      y = "% of Acceptances After Cross-Clamp"
    ) +
    ylim(0, max(prop_data$prop) * 1.2) +
    theme_gastro(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Helvetica", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Helvetica"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Helvetica"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}
```

```{r fig2-cumulative-table}
# cumulative % at these time points
time_points <- c(-30, -20, -10, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 20)

cumulative_table_list <- list()
for (tp in time_points) {
  temp_data <- final_plot_data %>%
    group_by(donation_type, seq_flag) %>%
    summarise(
      time_point = tp,
      n_accepted = sum(diff_final_clamp <= tp, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_total = n(),
      cumulative_prop = (n_accepted / n_total) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

}

cumulative_table_data <- bind_rows(cumulative_table_list) %>%
  mutate(
    seq_flag_clean = case_when(
      seq_flag == "<50 sequence" ~ "<50",
      seq_flag == "≥50 sequence" ~ "≥50",
      seq_flag == "AOOS (out-of-sequence)" ~ "AOOS",
      TRUE ~ seq_flag
    )
  ) %>%
  select(donation_type, seq_flag_clean, time_point, cumulative_prop) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(donation_type, seq_flag_clean),
    values_from = cumulative_prop,
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  arrange(time_point) %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.1f%%", .x))
  ) %>%
  rename(
    `Time Point (hours)` = time_point
  ) %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ gsub("^DBD_", "DBD ", .x),
    starts_with("DBD_")
  ) %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ gsub("^DCD_", "DCD ", .x),
    starts_with("DCD_")
  )
```

```{r figSF6-data-prep}
# 3 colors: lighter blue, darker blue, orange

  "≥50 sequence" = "#00468B",
  "AOOS (out-of-sequence)" = "#FF8C00"
)

sf6_counts <- final_plot_data_sf6 %>%
  group_by(seq_flag_3group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
n_lt50 <- sf6_counts$n[sf6_counts$seq_flag_3group == "<50 sequence"]
n_ge50 <- sf6_counts$n[sf6_counts$seq_flag_3group == "≥50 sequence"]
n_aoos_sf6 <- sf6_counts$n[sf6_counts$seq_flag_3group == "AOOS (out-of-sequence)"]

box_medians_sf6 <- final_plot_data_sf6 %>%
  group_by(donation_type, seq_flag_3group) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(diff_final_clamp, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(diff_final_clamp, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r figSF6-plot-functions}
# plot helpers for 3 groups
make_cumulative_plot_3group <- function(data, donor_type_filter, plot_label) {
  plot_data <- data %>% filter(donation_type == donor_type_filter)
  max_val <- max(plot_data$diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = diff_final_clamp, color = seq_flag_3group)) +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", 
               linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-50, max_val)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = SEQUENCE_COLORS_3GROUP, name = "Sequence Group") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), 
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_label,
      x = "Hours from Cross-Clamp",
      y = "Cumulative Proportion of Acceptance"
    ) +
    theme_gastro(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Helvetica", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Helvetica"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Helvetica"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.05, label = "Cross-clamp", 
             angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, 
             fontface = "bold", color = "black", family = "Helvetica")
}

make_boxplot_3group <- function(data, plot_label) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = donation_type, y = diff_final_clamp, fill = seq_flag_3group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", 
               alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_boxplot(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
      alpha = 0.9, 
      outlier.alpha = 0.5, 
      outlier.size = 1.5, 
      linewidth = 0.8,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = SEQUENCE_COLORS_3GROUP, name = "Sequence Group") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-50, max(data$diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE))) +
    labs(
      title = plot_label,
      x = "Donation Type",
      y = "Timing of Acceptance (hours from cross-clamp)"
    ) +
    theme_gastro(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Helvetica", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Helvetica"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Helvetica"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.42, y = 2, label = "Cross-clamp", 
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", 
             color = "black", family = "Helvetica")
}

make_proportion_plot_3group <- function(data) {
  prop_data <- data %>%
    group_by(donation_type, seq_flag_3group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_post = sum(diff_final_clamp > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      total = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      prop = (n_post / total) * 100,
      label = paste0(n_post, "/", total, "\n(", round(prop, 1), "%)")
    )
  
  ggplot(prop_data, aes(x = donation_type, y = prop, fill = seq_flag_3group)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label), 
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
      vjust = -0.3, 
      size = 3.0, 
      fontface = "bold",
      family = "Helvetica"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = SEQUENCE_COLORS_3GROUP, name = "Sequence Group") +
    labs(
      title = "D",
      x = "Donation Type",
      y = "% of Acceptances After Cross-Clamp"
    ) +
    ylim(0, max(prop_data$prop) * 1.2) +
    theme_gastro(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Helvetica", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Helvetica"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Helvetica"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}
```

```{r figSF6-plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
p_sf6_dbd <- make_cumulative_plot_3group(final_plot_data_sf6, "DBD", "A: DBD")
p_sf6_dcd <- make_cumulative_plot_3group(final_plot_data_sf6, "DCD", "B: DCD")
p_sf6_box <- make_boxplot_3group(final_plot_data_sf6, "C")
p_sf6_proportion <- make_proportion_plot_3group(final_plot_data_sf6)

# legend like Fig 2
legend_data_sf6 <- data.frame(
  x = 1:3,
  y = 1,
  allocation_type = names(SEQUENCE_COLORS_3GROUP)
)

color_key_sf6 <- ggplot(legend_data_sf6, aes(x = x, y = y, color = allocation_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = SEQUENCE_COLORS_3GROUP,
    name = "Allocation Type"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, family = "Helvetica"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Helvetica"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 8, b = 8, l = 8, r = 8),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
    plot.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))

final_combined_plot_sf6 <- ((p_sf6_dbd | p_sf6_dcd) / 
                            (p_sf6_box | p_sf6_proportion)) /
  color_key_sf6 +
```

**Figure SF6. Response timing relative to cross-clamp by donor type and allocation type, with in-sequence allocation stratified by sequence number at acceptance.** (A-B) Cumulative distribution curves showing timing of final organ acceptance relative to donor cross-clamp for DBD and DCD donors, stratified by sequence group (\<50, ≥50, or AOOS). (C) Box plots comparing response timing distributions across donation types and sequence groups. Dashed line at 0 hours represents cross-clamp time. (D) Proportion of cases where final acceptance occurred after cross-clamp. N = `r comma(nrow(final_plot_data_sf6))` cases (\<50 sequence: `r comma(n_lt50)`, ≥50 sequence: `r comma(n_ge50)`, AOOS: `r comma(n_aoos_sf6)`).

```{r fig4-panel-a-prep}
# OPO-level AOOS rate (%)
opo_summary <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
      TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
    ),
    offer_type = ifelse(is_open_offer == TRUE, "Open Offer", "Sequential")
  ) %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE = OPO_CTR_CODE_current, offer_type) %>%
  summarise(n_transplants = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = n_transplants, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    total = `Open Offer` + Sequential,
    aoos_rate = if_else(total > 0, 100 * `Open Offer` / total, 0)
  )

# join to geography
geo_heatmap_data <- opo_summary %>%
  left_join(opo_direct_mapping, by = "OPO_CTR_CODE") %>%
  left_join(dsa, by = c("OPO_PROVIDER_NUM" = "OPO_PROVIDER_NUM")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(OPO_PROVIDER_NUM)) %>%
  st_as_sf()
```

```{r fig3-panel-c-prep}
  max(dsri_geo_data_sequential$median_dsri_sequential, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```

```{r fig3-opo-stats, echo=FALSE}
# per-OPO stats for text
opo_stats_table <- opo_summary %>%
```

## Figure 5: OPO-Center Pair Analysis by AOOS Rate

```{r fig5-prep}
# OPO–center pair stats: counts then filter to above-median, top 10 by AOOS rate
opo_center_counts_fig5 <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
      TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
    ),
    offer_type = ifelse(is_open_offer == TRUE, "AOOS", "Sequential")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE_current) & !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE)) %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE = OPO_CTR_CODE_current, LISTING_CTR_CODE, offer_type) %>%
  summarise(n_offers = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = n_offers, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    # Anonymize codes
    OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE),
    Center_anon = anonymize_center_vec(LISTING_CTR_CODE),
    pair_label = paste0(OPO_anon, " → ", Center_anon),
    total = AOOS + Sequential,
    aoos_rate = if_else(total > 0, 100 * AOOS / total, 0)
  )

# medians: one pair per center (same idea as SF7)
one_pair_per_center_fig5 <- opo_center_counts_fig5 %>%
  filter(AOOS > 0) %>%
  group_by(LISTING_CTR_CODE) %>%
  slice_max(AOOS, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

median_center_counts_fig5 <- opo_center_counts_fig5 %>%
  inner_join(one_pair_per_center_fig5 %>% select(OPO_CTR_CODE, LISTING_CTR_CODE), 
             by = c("OPO_CTR_CODE", "LISTING_CTR_CODE")) %>%
  summarise(
    AOOS = median(AOOS, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sequential = median(Sequential, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

median_aoos_count_fig5 <- ifelse(nrow(median_center_counts_fig5) > 0 && "AOOS" %in% names(median_center_counts_fig5), 
                                 median_center_counts_fig5$AOOS[1], 0)
median_seq_count_fig5 <- ifelse(nrow(median_center_counts_fig5) > 0 && "Sequential" %in% names(median_center_counts_fig5), 
                               median_center_counts_fig5$Sequential[1], 0)

cat("Median AOOS count (for filtering):", median_aoos_count_fig5, "\n")
cat("Median In-Sequence count (for filtering):", median_seq_count_fig5, "\n\n")

# above-median pairs, then top 10 by AOOS rate
above_median_pairs_fig5 <- opo_center_counts_fig5 %>%
  filter(AOOS > median_aoos_count_fig5 & Sequential > median_seq_count_fig5) %>%
  arrange(desc(aoos_rate))

top_10_pairs_fig5 <- above_median_pairs_fig5 %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(pair_label)

# median rate/counts one-pair-per-center (for reference)
median_pair_rate_fig5 <- median(one_pair_per_center_fig5$aoos_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
median_pair_counts_fig5 <- one_pair_per_center_fig5 %>%
  summarise(
    median_aoos = median(AOOS, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_sequential = median(Sequential, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Top 10 OPO-Center pairs by AOOS rate (from above-median pairs):\n")
print(above_median_pairs_fig5 %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% select(pair_label, AOOS, Sequential, total, aoos_rate))
cat("\nMedian pair rate (one-pair-per-center):", round(median_pair_rate_fig5, 1), "%\n")
cat("Median AOOS count (one-pair-per-center):", median_pair_counts_fig5$median_aoos, "\n")
cat("Median In-Sequence count (one-pair-per-center):", median_pair_counts_fig5$median_sequential, "\n\n")

# Panel A: counts + AOOS rate labels
pair_rates_for_labels <- above_median_pairs_fig5 %>%
  filter(pair_label %in% top_10_pairs_fig5) %>%
  select(pair_label, aoos_rate) %>%
  mutate(
    pair_label_fct = factor(pair_label, levels = rev(top_10_pairs_fig5)),

  )

# factor order: top 10 reverse (highest at top when flipped), median at bottom
pair_counts_for_plot <- above_median_pairs_fig5 %>%
  filter(pair_label %in% top_10_pairs_fig5) %>%
  select(pair_label, AOOS, Sequential) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(AOOS, Sequential), names_to = "offer_type", values_to = "n_offers") %>%

reference_label_fig5 <- "Median"
median_aoos_rate_label_fig5 <- paste0(round(median_pair_rate_fig5, 1), "%")

# median at bottom in factor

pair_rates_for_labels <- pair_rates_for_labels %>%

# Panel B: median proximity to clamp per pair
pair_timing_for_plot <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",

    ),

  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE_current) & !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE) & !is.na(diff_final_clamp) &

  mutate(
    pair_label_fct = factor(pair_label, levels = c(reference_label_fig5, rev(top_10_pairs_fig5)))
  )

# median timing one-pair-per-center (for reference)
median_pair_timing_fig5 <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
      TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
    ),
    offer_type = ifelse(is_open_offer == TRUE, "AOOS", "Sequential"),
    # Anonymize codes
    OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE_current),

  summarise(median_time_to_clamp = median(diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(offer_type) %>%
  summarise(median_time_to_clamp = median(median_time_to_clamp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# add median row to timing plot
```

**Figure 5. OPO-Center Pair Analysis: Top 10 Pairs by AOOS Rate.** Top 10 OPO-Center pairs ranked by AOOS (Allocation Out-of-Sequence) rate from pairs above median for both AOOS and In-Sequence counts, plus median reference (11th entry). The median reference was calculated as the median AOOS rate across above-median pairs. All panels compare AOOS vs In-Sequence allocation types. Y-axis labels show OPO and Listing Center codes.

**(A) Raw counts (n) of transplants** for top 10 OPO-Center pairs by AOOS rate (from above-median pairs), plus median count across above-median pairs (reference).

**(B) Median time from acceptance to cross-clamp** (hours; negative = pre-clamp, 0 = at clamp, positive = post-clamp). Each pair shows median for that specific pair; reference shows median across above-median pairs. Shown as filled circles connected by lines.

## Figure 4: Distance Differential and Center Aggressiveness

```{r fig6-prep}
# center name lookups (if needed)
if (!exists("listing_center_names")) {
  ctr_unos <- read_csv("~center UNOS new.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
  listing_center_names <- ctr_unos %>%
    select(LISTING_CTR_CODE, LISTING_CTR) %>%
    filter(!is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE)) %>%
    mutate(
      LISTING_CTR_clean = case_when(
        !is.na(LISTING_CTR) & LISTING_CTR != "" ~ LISTING_CTR,
        TRUE ~ LISTING_CTR_CODE
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(LISTING_CTR_CODE) %>%
    summarise(LISTING_CTR = first(LISTING_CTR_clean), .groups = "drop")
}

# center stats: sequential offers only
sequential_offers_aggr <- timing_cohort %>%
  filter(is_open_offer == FALSE,
         !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE),
         !is.na(n_unique_ctr_contacted)) %>%
  mutate(n_rejections_before_acceptance = n_unique_ctr_contacted - 1)

center_summary_aggr <- sequential_offers_aggr %>%
  left_join(listing_center_names, by = "LISTING_CTR_CODE") %>%
  group_by(LISTING_CTR_CODE, LISTING_CTR) %>%
  summarise(
    n_offers = n(),
    max_rejections = max(n_rejections_before_acceptance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_after_10_rejections = sum(n_rejections_before_acceptance >= 10),
    pct_after_10_rejections = round(100 * sum(n_rejections_before_acceptance >= 10) / n(), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# all centers for B and C (not just >= 10 sequential)
centers_robust_aggr <- center_summary_aggr
# tertiles by rank (ntile); 0 sequential -> Low
centers_robust_aggr <- centers_robust_aggr %>%
  arrange(n_after_10_rejections) %>%
  mutate(
    tertile = ntile(n_after_10_rejections, 3),
    category_by_count = case_when(
      tertile == 3 ~ "High: Frequently Accept After ≥10 Rejections",
      tertile == 2 ~ "Medium: Occasionally Accept After ≥10 Rejections",
      tertile == 1 ~ "Low: Rarely Accept After ≥10 Rejections"
    ),
    category_by_count = factor(
      category_by_count,
      levels = c("Low: Rarely Accept After ≥10 Rejections",
                 "Medium: Occasionally Accept After ≥10 Rejections",
                 "High: Frequently Accept After ≥10 Rejections"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

tertile_cutoffs <- centers_robust_aggr %>%
  group_by(tertile) %>%
  summarise(
    min_value = min(n_after_10_rejections, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_value = max(n_after_10_rejections, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_centers = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(tertile)

cat("Tertile Cutoff Values:\n")
cat("======================\n")
cat("Low (Tertile 1): ", tertile_cutoffs$min_value[1], " to ", tertile_cutoffs$max_value[1], " (n = ", tertile_cutoffs$n_centers[1], " centers)\n", sep = "")
cat("Medium (Tertile 2): ", tertile_cutoffs$min_value[2], " to ", tertile_cutoffs$max_value[2], " (n = ", tertile_cutoffs$n_centers[2], " centers)\n", sep = "")
cat("High (Tertile 3): ", tertile_cutoffs$min_value[3], " to ", tertile_cutoffs$max_value[3], " (n = ", tertile_cutoffs$n_centers[3], " centers)\n", sep = "")
cat("\n")

# n per category for legend
n_high <- sum(centers_robust_aggr$category_by_count == "High: Frequently Accept After ≥10 Rejections", na.rm = TRUE)
n_medium <- sum(centers_robust_aggr$category_by_count == "Medium: Occasionally Accept After ≥10 Rejections", na.rm = TRUE)
n_low <- sum(centers_robust_aggr$category_by_count == "Low: Rarely Accept After ≥10 Rejections", na.rm = TRUE)
n_total_centers <- nrow(centers_robust_aggr)

legend_label_high <- paste0("High: Frequently Accept (", n_high, " centers)")
legend_label_medium <- paste0("Medium: Occasionally Accept (", n_medium, " centers)")
legend_label_low <- paste0("Low: Rarely Accept (", n_low, " centers)")
```

```{r fig6-panel-c-new-scatter, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=6}
# Panel C: sequential after >10 rejections vs AOOS accepted
aoos_by_center <- timing_cohort %>%
  filter(is_open_offer == TRUE, !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE)) %>%
  group_by(LISTING_CTR_CODE) %>%
  summarise(n_aoos_accepted = n(), .groups = "drop")

centers_with_aoos <- centers_robust_aggr %>%
  left_join(aoos_by_center, by = "LISTING_CTR_CODE") %>%
  mutate(n_aoos_accepted = replace_na(n_aoos_accepted, 0))

cor_test_result <- cor.test(centers_with_aoos$n_after_10_rejections, 
                            centers_with_aoos$n_aoos_accepted, 
                            method = "spearman")
spearman_rho <- round(cor_test_result$estimate, 3)
spearman_p <- cor_test_result$p.value

if (spearman_p < 0.001) {
  p_text <- "P < 0.001"
} else if (spearman_p < 0.01) {
  p_text <- paste0("P < 0.01")
} else if (spearman_p < 0.05) {
  p_text <- paste0("P < 0.05")
} else {
  p_text <- paste0("P = ", sprintf("%.3f", spearman_p))
}

cor_text <- paste0("ρ = ", spearman_rho, ", ", p_text)

cat("\n=== SPEARMAN CORRELATION: Panel B ===\n")
cat("Correlation coefficient (ρ):", spearman_rho, "\n")
cat("P-value:", spearman_p, "\n")
cat("Formatted:", cor_text, "\n\n")

x_max <- max(centers_with_aoos$n_after_10_rejections, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(centers_with_aoos$n_aoos_accepted, na.rm = TRUE)

p3_scatter_aoos_vs_sequential <- centers_with_aoos %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_after_10_rejections, y = n_aoos_accepted, 
             fill = category_by_count)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, stroke = 1, shape = 21, color = "black", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("High: Frequently Accept After ≥10 Rejections" = "#D02670",  # IBM Magenta
               "Medium: Occasionally Accept After ≥10 Rejections" = "#8A3FFC",  # IBM Purple
               "Low: Rarely Accept After ≥10 Rejections" = "#24A148"),  # IBM Green
    guide = "none"  # Hide color legend - it's shown in Panel D
  ) +
  # Add correlation annotation in top-left corner
  annotate("text", 
           x = x_max * 0.02, 
           y = y_max * 1.02,
           label = cor_text,
           hjust = 0,
           vjust = 1,
           size = 4,
           fontface = "bold",
           family = "Helvetica",
           color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "B",
    x = "Number of In-Sequence Offers Accepted\nAfter ≥10 Centers Rejected",
    y = "Total Number of AOOS Offers Accepted"
  ) +
  theme_gastro(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Helvetica", margin = margin(b = 8)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Helvetica"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Helvetica"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p3_scatter_aoos_vs_sequential)
ggsave("figures/main/Figure4C_New_Scatter.png", p3_scatter_aoos_vs_sequential, width = 6.5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r fig6-panel-b-stacked, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=7}
# Panel D: stacked AOOS distribution
```

**Figure 4. Distance differential and center aggressiveness by tertiles.** Centers were grouped into tertiles by the number of sequential offers they accepted after ≥10 prior centers declined (Low, Medium, High; equal-sized groups). (A) Scatterplot showing number of sequential offers accepted after ≥10 centers rejected (x-axis) versus total number of sequential offers accepted (y-axis). Points colored by tertile. (B) Scatterplot showing number of sequential offers accepted after ≥10 centers rejected (x-axis) versus total number of AOOS offers accepted (y-axis). Points colored by tertile. (C) Distribution of AOOS offers received by centers, stacked bar by tertile. (D) Mean AOOS rate by tertile, percentage of total transplants per center for each tertile category. (E) Distance difference between sequential and AOOS offers by OPO. Bars show median nautical-mile differences (sequential minus AOOS), segmented by tertile. Positive values indicate sequential offers traveled farther; negative values indicate AOOS offers traveled farther.

```{r fig7-panel-a-prep}
# % of offers to centers by acceptance category per OPO (same categories as Fig 6)
center_acceptance_proportions <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
      TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DISTANCE) & !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE)) %>%
  left_join(
    centers_robust_aggr %>% select(LISTING_CTR_CODE, category_by_count),
    by = "LISTING_CTR_CODE"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(category_by_count)) %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE = OPO_CTR_CODE_current, category_by_count) %>%
  summarise(n_offers = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE) %>%
  mutate(
    total_offers = sum(n_offers),
    proportion = n_offers / total_offers
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# distance difference data
distance_data_s10_6 <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
      TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
    ),
    offer_type = ifelse(is_open_offer == TRUE, "Open Offer", "Sequential")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DISTANCE)) %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE = OPO_CTR_CODE_current, offer_type) %>%
  summarise(
    median_distance = median(DISTANCE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = offer_type,
    values_from = c(median_distance, n),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`median_distance_Open Offer`) & !is.na(`median_distance_Sequential`)) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_diff = `median_distance_Sequential` - `median_distance_Open Offer`,
    OPO_short = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE),  # Anonymize OPO codes
    n_open_offers = `n_Open Offer`,
    n_sequential = `n_Sequential`,
    total_n = n_open_offers + n_sequential,
    label_text = paste0(OPO_short, "\n(n=", n_open_offers, ")")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_diff))

# drop extreme outliers for plot
distance_plot_data_s10_6 <- distance_data_s10_6 %>%
  filter(abs(distance_diff) <= 300)

# totals for annotations
total_n_positive <- sum(distance_plot_data_s10_6$n_open_offers[distance_plot_data_s10_6$distance_diff > 0])
total_n_negative <- sum(distance_plot_data_s10_6$n_open_offers[distance_plot_data_s10_6$distance_diff < 0])

# prep for stacked bars
stacked_acceptance_data <- distance_plot_data_s10_6 %>%
  select(OPO_CTR_CODE, OPO_short, distance_diff, n_open_offers, label_text) %>%
  left_join(center_acceptance_proportions, by = "OPO_CTR_CODE") %>%
  arrange(OPO_CTR_CODE, match(category_by_count, c("High: Frequently Accept After ≥10 Rejections", 
                                                      "Medium: Occasionally Accept After ≥10 Rejections",
                                                      "Low: Rarely Accept After ≥10 Rejections"))) %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE) %>%
  mutate(
    category_by_count = factor(
      category_by_count,
      levels = c("High: Frequently Accept After ≥10 Rejections", 
                 "Medium: Occasionally Accept After ≥10 Rejections",
                 "Low: Rarely Accept After ≥10 Rejections")
    ),
    cumsum_prop = cumsum(proportion),
    cumsum_prop_prev = lag(cumsum_prop, default = 0),
    ymin = ifelse(distance_diff >= 0, 
                  distance_diff * cumsum_prop_prev,
                  distance_diff * cumsum_prop),
    ymax = ifelse(distance_diff >= 0,
                  distance_diff * cumsum_prop,
                  distance_diff * cumsum_prop_prev)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r fig4-opo-stats-table, echo=FALSE}
# per-OPO table for Fig 4: sequential after ≥10 rejections
sequential_after_10_per_opo <- timing_cohort %>%
  filter(is_open_offer == FALSE, !is.na(n_unique_ctr_contacted)) %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
      TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
    ),
    n_rejections_before_acceptance = n_unique_ctr_contacted - 1
  ) %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE = OPO_CTR_CODE_current) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sequential_accepted = n(),
    n_sequential_after_10_rejections = sum(n_rejections_before_acceptance >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

opo_stats_fig4 <- distance_plot_data_s10_6 %>%
  select(OPO_CTR_CODE, OPO_short, 
         median_distance_AOOS = `median_distance_Open Offer`,
         median_distance_Sequential = `median_distance_Sequential`,
         median_distance_diff = distance_diff,
         n_sequential = n_sequential) %>%
  left_join(sequential_after_10_per_opo, by = "OPO_CTR_CODE") %>%
  mutate(
    median_distance_AOOS = round(median_distance_AOOS, 1),
    median_distance_Sequential = round(median_distance_Sequential, 1),
    median_distance_diff = round(median_distance_diff, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_distance_diff)) %>%
  select(OPO_anon, n_sequential_accepted, n_sequential_after_10_rejections,
         median_distance_AOOS, median_distance_Sequential, median_distance_diff) %>%
  rename(
    `OPO` = OPO_anon,
    `N Sequential Accepted` = n_sequential_accepted,
    `N Sequential After ≥10 Rejections` = n_sequential_after_10_rejections,
    `Median Distance AOOS (nm)` = median_distance_AOOS,
    `Median Distance In-Sequence (nm)` = median_distance_Sequential,
    `Median Distance Difference (nm)` = median_distance_diff
  )
```

```{r figSF1-consort, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
load(here("data_processed", "01_raw_data.rda"))

date_start <- date_lb
date_end <- max(timing_cohort$TX_DATE, na.rm = TRUE)

  month_name <- format(date, "%b")
  year <- format(date, "%Y")
  paste0(month_name, " ", year)
}

date_range_text <- paste0(format_date_short(date_start), " - ", format_date_short(date_end))

timing_cohort_breakdown <- table(timing_cohort$seq_flag)
get_count <- function(nm) if (nm %in% names(timing_cohort_breakdown)) as.integer(timing_cohort_breakdown[[nm]]) else 0L

n_in_sequence <- get_count("<50 sequence") + get_count("≥50 sequence")
n_aoos <- get_count("AOOS (out-of-sequence)")

breakdown_text <- paste0(
  "In-Sequence: ", format(n_in_sequence, big.mark = ","), "\\n",
  "AOOS: ", format(n_aoos, big.mark = ",")

# discarded = not in liver_data; AOOS at donor level

OPEN_OFFER_TEXT_CODES <- c(798L, 799L, 898L)

ptr_filtered_na <- ptr_reduced %>%
  filter(!is.na(MATCH_DATE), as.Date(MATCH_DATE) >= as.Date("2021-12-09"))

all_donors_ptr <- ptr_filtered_na %>%

# Get transplanted donors (in liver_data)

  distinct(DONOR_ID)

# discarded_complete from 03 (consistent)

discarded_counts_complete <- discarded_complete %>%
  count(allocation_type) %>%

n_discarded_aoos <- discarded_counts_complete$AOOS[1]

n_discarded_total <- nrow(discarded_donors_total)
n_discarded_with_donor_type <- nrow(discarded_complete)
n_discarded_dbd <- sum(discarded_complete$donor_type == "DBD", na.rm = TRUE)
n_discarded_dcd <- sum(discarded_complete$donor_type == "DCD", na.rm = TRUE)

# recovered not transplanted: join donor_reduced for NUM_LI_RECOV
recovered_not_tx_sf1 <- discarded_complete %>%

# label order: AOOS, In-Sequence, Total

consort_diagram <- grViz(glue("
digraph consort {{

  X1 [label='Excluded:\\nTransplants without accepted offer\\nrecords in PTR dataset\\n(often living donor)\\nN = {format(counts$n_initial - counts$n_after_join, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='#FFE6E6', color='#CC0000']
  X2 [label='Excluded:\\nMulti-organ transplants\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_join - counts$n_after_multiorg, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X3 [label='Excluded:\\nLiving donor transplants\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_multiorg - counts$n_after_living, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X4 [label='Excluded:\\nSplit liver cases\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_living - counts$n_after_split, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X5 [label='Excluded:\\nDuplicate donors\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_split - counts$n_after_dedup, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X6 [label='Excluded:\\nDirected donations\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_dedup - counts$n_after_directed, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X7_TIMING [label='Excluded:\\nFinal acceptance response\\nafter transplant date\\n(plausibility exclusion)\\nN = 433', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X8_MELD [label='Excluded:\\nMissing donor data\\nN = {format(counts$n_before_step9 - counts$n_final, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']

  A -> B; B -> C; C -> D; D -> E; E -> F; F -> G; G -> G1; G1 -> G2; G2 -> H
  H -> spacer [style=invis]
  spacer -> I [style=invis]
  J -> I1
  I1 -> I
  I -> Recovered [style=dashed, arrowhead=normal, color='#999999']
  {{rank=same; H; spacer; I; Recovered}}
  A -> X1 [arrowhead=none, color='#CC0000', style=bold]
  B -> X2 [arrowhead=none, color='#BBBBBB']

  G1 -> X8_MELD [arrowhead=none, color='#BBBBBB']
}}
"))

```

**Figure SF1. Cohort flow diagram showing construction and exclusions from OPTN STAR files joining liver waitlist, deceased donor and potential transplant recipient datasets.** Starting with all liver transplants from December 9, 2021 to April 30, 2025, sequential exclusion criteria were applied to create the final analysis cohort of `r format(nrow(timing_cohort), big.mark=",")` cases with plausible timing data. A dashed arrow from not transplanted indicates the subset recovered but not transplanted (NUM_LI_RECOV &gt; 0), used in supplement analyses.

## Figure SF2: Survival by Donor Type and Allocation Pathway

```{r figSF2-survival-prep}
# survival: timing_cohort
surv_df <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    seq_flag = factor(seq_flag, levels = c("<50 sequence", "≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)")),
    PTIME_yrs = PTIME / 365.25,
    GTIME_yrs = GTIME / 365.25,
    donation_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    donation_type = factor(donation_type, levels = c("DBD", "DCD"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(donation_type), !is.na(PSTATUS), !is.na(GSTATUS)) %>%
  droplevels()

surv_dcd <- surv_df %>% filter(donation_type == "DCD") %>% droplevels()
surv_dbd <- surv_df %>% filter(donation_type == "DBD") %>% droplevels()

# reference: <50 sequence
surv_dcd$seq_flag <- relevel(surv_dcd$seq_flag, ref = "<50 sequence")
surv_dbd$seq_flag <- relevel(surv_dbd$seq_flag, ref = "<50 sequence")

fit_patient_dcd <- survfit(Surv(PTIME_yrs, PSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dcd)
fit_graft_dcd <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_yrs, GSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dcd)
fit_patient_dbd <- survfit(Surv(PTIME_yrs, PSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dbd)
fit_graft_dbd <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_yrs, GSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dbd)

# log-rank for 3 groups
pval_patient_dcd <- survminer::surv_pvalue(fit_patient_dcd, data = surv_dcd)$pval
pval_graft_dcd <- survminer::surv_pvalue(fit_graft_dcd, data = surv_dcd)$pval
pval_patient_dbd <- survminer::surv_pvalue(fit_patient_dbd, data = surv_dbd)$pval
pval_graft_dbd <- survminer::surv_pvalue(fit_graft_dbd, data = surv_dbd)$pval

labs_short <- c("<50", "≥50", "AOOS")
# 3-group palette
pal <- c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#d62728")  # Blue, Orange, Red for <50, ≥50, AOOS
```

## Supplemental Table 3: Survival Outcomes

```{r tableS3-survival-stats-prep}
# timing_cohort + survival vars
timing_cohort_surv <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    donation_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    PTIME_yrs = PTIME / 365.25,
    GTIME_yrs = GTIME / 365.25
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(donation_type), !is.na(PSTATUS), !is.na(GSTATUS)) %>%
  droplevels()
```

```{r tableS3-survival-stats}
extract_surv_stats <- function(fit, data, time_var, status_var, times = c(1, 2)) {
  ne <- data %>%
    count(seq_flag, name = "n") %>%
    left_join(
      data %>%
        group_by(seq_flag) %>%
        summarise(events = sum(.data[[status_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
      by = "seq_flag"
    )
  
  s <- summary(fit, times = times)
  surv_at_times <- tibble(
    seq_flag = sub("^seq_flag=", "", s$strata),
    time = s$time,
    surv = s$surv,
    lower = s$lower,
    upper = s$upper
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      surv_ci = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f–%.1f%%)", surv*100, lower*100, upper*100)
    ) %>%
    select(seq_flag, time, surv_ci) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = surv_ci, names_prefix = "yr_")
  
  # fill missing time cols with NA
  expected_cols <- paste0("yr_", times)
  for (col in expected_cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(surv_at_times)) {
      surv_at_times[[col]] <- NA_character_
    }
  }
  
  ne %>%
    left_join(surv_at_times, by = "seq_flag") %>%
    arrange(match(seq_flag, c("<50 sequence", "≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)")))
}

# Create datasets with all sequence groups for survival analysis
surv_dcd <- timing_cohort_surv %>% filter(donation_type == "DCD")
surv_dbd <- timing_cohort_surv %>% filter(donation_type == "DBD")

# Patient survival
fit_p_dcd <- survfit(Surv(PTIME_yrs, PSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dcd)
fit_p_dbd <- survfit(Surv(PTIME_yrs, PSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dbd)

# Graft survival  
fit_g_dcd <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_yrs, GSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dcd)
fit_g_dbd <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_yrs, GSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dbd)

surv_stats_p_dcd <- extract_surv_stats(fit_p_dcd, surv_dcd, "PTIME_yrs", "PSTATUS")
surv_stats_p_dbd <- extract_surv_stats(fit_p_dbd, surv_dbd, "PTIME_yrs", "PSTATUS")
surv_stats_g_dcd <- extract_surv_stats(fit_g_dcd, surv_dcd, "GTIME_yrs", "GSTATUS")
surv_stats_g_dbd <- extract_surv_stats(fit_g_dbd, surv_dbd, "GTIME_yrs", "GSTATUS")

surv_table <- bind_rows(
  surv_stats_p_dcd %>% mutate(donor_type = "DCD", outcome = "Patient"),
  surv_stats_p_dbd %>% mutate(donor_type = "DBD", outcome = "Patient"),
  surv_stats_g_dcd %>% mutate(donor_type = "DCD", outcome = "Graft"),
  surv_stats_g_dbd %>% mutate(donor_type = "DBD", outcome = "Graft")
) %>%
  select(donor_type, outcome, seq_flag, n, events, any_of(c("yr_1", "yr_2"))) %>%
  arrange(donor_type, outcome, match(seq_flag, c("<50 sequence", "≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)")))

# Create column labels dynamically based on what's available
surv_table_display <- surv_table %>%
  gt(groupname_col = c("donor_type", "outcome")) %>%
  cols_label(
    seq_flag = "Allocation Group",
    n = "N",
    events = "Events"
  )

# time col labels if present
if ("yr_1" %in% names(surv_table)) {
  surv_table_display <- surv_table_display %>% cols_label(yr_1 = "1 Year")
}
if ("yr_2" %in% names(surv_table)) {
  surv_table_display <- surv_table_display %>% cols_label(yr_2 = "2 Years")
}

surv_table_display <- surv_table_display %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 10,
    row_group.font.size = 11
  )

surv_table_display
```

## Threshold Analysis: \>4 Hours Pre-Clamp Rule

```{r threshold-analysis, echo=FALSE}
# Threshold: >4 hours pre-clamp means include everything at or AFTER that point (diff_final_clamp >= -4)
# Exclude everything BEFORE that point (diff_final_clamp < -4, meaning more than 4 hours before clamp)
# Using timing_cohort to match the same exclusions as the graphs (excludes implausible final responses after tx_date, etc.)

aoos_threshold <- timing_cohort %>%
  filter(is_open_offer == TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_aoos = n(),
    excluded_aoos = sum(diff_final_clamp < -4, na.rm = TRUE),  # Before threshold (more than 4 hours before clamp)
    pct_excluded = round(100 * excluded_aoos / total_aoos, 1),
    included_aoos = sum(diff_final_clamp >= -4, na.rm = TRUE),  # At or after threshold
    pct_included = round(100 * included_aoos / total_aoos, 1)
  )

# sequential from ≥-4 hr onwards
sequential_threshold <- timing_cohort %>%
  filter(is_open_offer == FALSE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sequential = n(),
    from_4hr_preclamp = sum(diff_final_clamp >= -4, na.rm = TRUE),  # At or after threshold
    pct_from_4hr = round(100 * from_4hr_preclamp / total_sequential, 1)
  )

cat("If open offers were only allowed at or AFTER >4 hours pre-clamp threshold (i.e., exclude if accepted BEFORE >4 hours pre-clamp):\n")
cat("  Total open offers: ", comma(aoos_threshold$total_aoos), "\n")
cat("  Open offers EXCLUDED (before threshold, diff_final_clamp < -4): ", comma(aoos_threshold$excluded_aoos), " (", aoos_threshold$pct_excluded, "%)\n")
cat("  Open offers INCLUDED (at or after threshold, diff_final_clamp >= -4): ", comma(aoos_threshold$included_aoos), " (", aoos_threshold$pct_included, "%)\n\n")
cat("For sequential offers (from >4 hours pre-clamp onwards):\n")
cat("  Total sequential offers: ", comma(sequential_threshold$total_sequential), "\n")
cat("  In-Sequence offers at or after threshold (diff_final_clamp >= -4): ", comma(sequential_threshold$from_4hr_preclamp), " (", sequential_threshold$pct_from_4hr, "%)\n")
```

## Utilization by Time Point Relative to Cross-Clamp

We examined utilization counts and rates for organs that remained unaccepted at different time points relative to cross-clamp, comparing AOOS versus In-Sequence allocation. At 4 hours before cross-clamp, among organs still unaccepted at that time point, AOOS had higher utilization rates than In-Sequence (58.1% vs 7.7% ultimately utilized). This inflection point at approximately 4 hours pre-clamp represents the time when AOOS allocation becomes more likely to result in utilization compared to In-Sequence allocation. Even after cross-clamp, the advantage persists: at 4 hours after cross-clamp, 33.5% of AOOS organs still unaccepted at that time were ultimately utilized, compared to 1.6% of In-Sequence organs.

## Figure 6: Utilization Timing and OPO Compliance

```{r utilization-by-time-point, echo=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=6}
# Fig 6A: utilization rate at each time point before clamp (AOOS vs Sequential)

# AOOS identification: refusal codes and text pattern
if (!exists("OPEN_OFFER_BYPASS_CODES")) {
  OPEN_OFFER_BYPASS_CODES <- c(861L, 862L, 863L, 887L, 888L, 760L, 761L, 762L, 763L, 764L, 765L)
  OPEN_OFFER_TEXT_CODES <- c(798L, 799L, 898L)
  OPEN_OFFER_TEXT_PATTERN <- regex("expedited|open offer|aggressive", ignore_case = TRUE)
}

# accepted organs with timing (from timing_cohort)
accepted_with_timing <- timing_cohort %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, diff_final_clamp, is_open_offer) %>%
  mutate(
    hours_from_clamp = diff_final_clamp,
    allocation_type = if_else(is_open_offer, "AOOS", "Sequential"),
    status = "Utilized"
  ) %>%
  select(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, hours_from_clamp, allocation_type, status)

# discarded = donors not in liver_data; AOOS at donor level (any match-run)
if (!exists("ptr_reduced")) {
  load(here("data_processed", "01_raw_data.rda"))
}

if (!exists("liver_reduced")) {
  load(here("data_processed", "01_raw_data.rda"))
}

# study period: on or after policy (2021-12-09)
ptr_filtered <- ptr_reduced %>%
  filter(!is.na(MATCH_DATE), as.Date(MATCH_DATE) >= as.Date("2021-12-09"))

all_donors_ptr <- ptr_filtered %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID)

# transplanted = in liver_data
transplanted_donors_cond <- liver_reduced %>%
  filter(!is.na(TX_DATE), !is.na(DONOR_ID)) %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID)

# Discarded = donors NOT in liver_data
discarded_donors_cond <- all_donors_ptr %>%
  filter(!DONOR_ID %in% transplanted_donors_cond$DONOR_ID)

# AOOS match-runs (all match-runs per donor)
aoos_keys_all_cond <- ptr_filtered %>%
  filter(
    # B = bypassed with AOOS codes
    ((OFFER_ACCEPT == "B") &
       (PRIME_OPO_REFUSAL_ID %in% OPEN_OFFER_BYPASS_CODES |
          (PRIME_OPO_REFUSAL_ID %in% OPEN_OFFER_TEXT_CODES &
             str_detect(tidyr::replace_na(OPO_OSTXT_PRIMARY, ""), OPEN_OFFER_TEXT_PATTERN)))) |
    # N = not accepted with AOOS text
      ((OFFER_ACCEPT == "N") &
         PRIME_OPO_REFUSAL_ID %in% OPEN_OFFER_TEXT_CODES &
         str_detect(tidyr::replace_na(OPO_OSTXT_PRIMARY, ""), OPEN_OFFER_TEXT_PATTERN))
  ) %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE)

donor_aoos_status_cond <- ptr_filtered %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE) %>%
  left_join(aoos_keys_all_cond %>% mutate(is_aoos = TRUE), by = c("DONOR_ID", "MATCH_ID_CODE")) %>%
  group_by(DONOR_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    has_aoos_match_run = any(!is.na(is_aoos) & is_aoos == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# use 03 discarded_complete for consistency
discarded_classified <- discarded_complete %>%
  select(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status)

never_accepted_with_clamp <- discarded_classified %>%
  mutate(MATCH_ID_CODE = DONOR_ID)

# totals for caption (unique donors)
total_accepted <- n_distinct(accepted_with_timing$DONOR_ID)
total_discarded <- nrow(discarded_classified)
total_aoos_accepted <- n_distinct(accepted_with_timing$DONOR_ID[accepted_with_timing$allocation_type == "AOOS"])
total_aoos_discarded <- sum(discarded_classified$allocation_type == "AOOS", na.rm = TRUE)
total_sequential_accepted <- n_distinct(accepted_with_timing$DONOR_ID[accepted_with_timing$allocation_type == "Sequential"])
total_sequential_discarded <- sum(discarded_classified$allocation_type == "Sequential", na.rm = TRUE)

total_never_accepted <- total_discarded
total_aoos_never_accepted <- total_aoos_discarded
total_sequential_never_accepted <- total_sequential_discarded

# utilization at each cutoff: organs still unaccepted at that hour -> ultimately utilized
cutoff_hours_range <- seq(-24, 24, by = 2)
cutoff_hours_with_labels <- seq(-24, 4, by = 4)

calculate_at_cutoff <- function(cutoff_hr) {
  accepted_at_cutoff <- accepted_with_timing %>%
    filter(hours_from_clamp >= cutoff_hr)
  
  # denominator = still unaccepted at cutoff (accepted at/after + discarded)
  combined <- bind_rows(
    accepted_at_cutoff %>% 
      distinct(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status) %>%  # Count unique donors, not match-runs
      select(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status),
    discarded_classified %>% 
      select(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status)
  )
  
  summary <- combined %>%
    filter(!is.na(allocation_type)) %>%
    # Count unique donors by allocation type and status (Utilized vs Discarded)
    group_by(allocation_type, status) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    # Reshape: columns = Utilized, Discarded; rows = AOOS, Sequential
    pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      cutoff_hours = cutoff_hr,
      # Total = all organs unaccepted at this cutoff time point
      Total = Utilized + Discarded,
      # Utilization rate = proportion of unaccepted organs that were ultimately utilized
      Pct_Utilized = round(100 * Utilized / Total, 1),
      Pct_Discarded = round(100 * Discarded / Total, 1)
    )
  
  return(summary)
}

plot_data <- bind_rows(lapply(cutoff_hours_range, calculate_at_cutoff))

plot_data_combined <- plot_data %>%
  select(cutoff_hours, allocation_type, Utilized, Pct_Utilized, Total) %>%

    # Create clean x-axis labels: show every 2 hours, with 0 at clamp
    x_label = if_else(cutoff_hours == 0, 
                      "0",
                      if_else(cutoff_hours < 0,
                              as.character(cutoff_hours),
                              paste0("+", cutoff_hours)))
  )

    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),

# table for figure caption
utilization_table <- plot_data %>%
  select(cutoff_hours, allocation_type, Utilized, Pct_Utilized, Total) %>%
  # Reshape to have AOOS and Sequential as columns
  pivot_wider(names_from = allocation_type, 
              values_from = c(Utilized, Pct_Utilized, Total),
              names_sep = "_") %>%
  # Create clean labels for cutoff hours
  mutate(
    Time_Point = if_else(cutoff_hours == 0, 
                         "0 (At clamp)",
                         if_else(cutoff_hours < 0,
                                 paste0(cutoff_hours, " hr before"),
                                 paste0("+", cutoff_hours, " hr after"))),
    # Format counts with commas

  ) %>%
  # Arrange by cutoff_hours first, then select columns
  arrange(cutoff_hours) %>%
  # Select final columns (cutoff_hours not included in final output)
  select(Time_Point, 
         AOOS_Count, AOOS_Proportion,
         Sequential_Count, Sequential_Proportion)

# Print table
cat("\n=== Table: Counts and Proportions at Each Cutoff Hour ===\n\n")
print(utilization_table, n = Inf)
cat("\n")

library(patchwork)
p_combined <- p1 + p1_prop + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 1), guides = "collect") &
```

```{r aoos-timing-analysis, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Fig 6B: OPO compliance with 4-hour rule (AOOS >= -4 hr from clamp)

ACCEPTABLE_AOOS_THRESHOLD <- -4

timing_cohort_opo <- timing_cohort %>%
  select(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, OPO_CTR_CODE) %>%
  # Remove duplicates, keeping one OPO code per donor-match combination
  distinct(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, .keep_all = TRUE)

aoos_timing_data <- timing_cohort %>%
  filter(is_open_offer == TRUE) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("OPO_CTR_CODE", "OPO_CTR_CODE.x", "OPO_CTR_CODE.y"))) %>%
  left_join(timing_cohort_opo, by = c("DONOR_ID", "MATCH_ID_CODE")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(diff_final_clamp), !is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE)) %>%
  mutate(
    hours_from_clamp = diff_final_clamp,
    meets_criterion = hours_from_clamp >= ACCEPTABLE_AOOS_THRESHOLD,
    OPO_label = paste0("OPO ", OPO_CTR_CODE)
  )

aoos_summary <- aoos_timing_data %>%
  summarise(
    total_aoos = n(),  # Total AOOS cases with timing and OPO data
    meets_criterion_n = sum(meets_criterion, na.rm = TRUE),  # Count meeting criterion
    meets_criterion_pct = round(100 * meets_criterion_n / total_aoos, 1),  # Compliance rate
    median_hours = round(median(hours_from_clamp, na.rm = TRUE), 1),  # Median timing
    q25_hours = round(quantile(hours_from_clamp, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),  # 25th percentile
    q75_hours = round(quantile(hours_from_clamp, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1)  # 75th percentile
  )

# Print overall summary statistics
cat("=== AOOS Timing Analysis: Acceptable Timing Within 4 Hours Before Cross-Clamp ===\n\n")
cat("Total AOOS cases with timing data:", aoos_summary$total_aoos, "\n")
cat("Cases meeting criterion (>= -4 hours):", aoos_summary$meets_criterion_n, "\n")
cat("Percentage meeting criterion:", aoos_summary$meets_criterion_pct, "%\n")
cat("Median hours from clamp:", aoos_summary$median_hours, "\n")
cat("IQR (Q1-Q3):", aoos_summary$q25_hours, "to", aoos_summary$q75_hours, "hours\n\n")

aoos_by_opo <- aoos_timing_data %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE, OPO_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),  # Total AOOS cases for this OPO
    n_meets_criterion = sum(meets_criterion, na.rm = TRUE),  # Cases meeting criterion
    pct_meets_criterion = round(100 * n_meets_criterion / n_total, 1),  # OPO compliance rate
    median_hours = round(median(hours_from_clamp, na.rm = TRUE), 1),  # OPO median timing
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Store overall average compliance for reference
overall_avg_pct <- aoos_summary$meets_criterion_pct

# Calculate stratified groups for results text (use current row order before re-arranging for plot)
opo_stratified <- aoos_by_opo %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      pct_meets_criterion >= 90 ~ "≥90%",
      pct_meets_criterion >= 80 & pct_meets_criterion < 90 ~ "80-89%",
      pct_meets_criterion >= 70 & pct_meets_criterion < 80 ~ "70-79%",
      pct_meets_criterion >= 60 & pct_meets_criterion < 70 ~ "60-69%",
      pct_meets_criterion < 60 ~ "<60%"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_opos = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(category))

# Print stratified summary
cat("\n=== OPO Stratification by Proportion Meeting Criterion ===\n")
print(opo_stratified)
cat("\n")

# sort OPOs by compliance (low to high), anonymize
aoos_by_opo <- aoos_by_opo %>%
  arrange(pct_meets_criterion, OPO_CTR_CODE) %>%
  mutate(OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(as.character(OPO_CTR_CODE)))

# unique() preserves order of first occurrence; needed if same OPO_anon appears more than once
opo_order <- unique(aoos_by_opo$OPO_anon)
aoos_by_opo <- aoos_by_opo %>%
  mutate(OPO_anon = factor(OPO_anon, levels = opo_order))

p_aoos_compliance <- ggplot(aoos_by_opo, aes(x = OPO_anon, y = pct_meets_criterion)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = overall_avg_pct, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "black", 
             linewidth = 0.8,
             alpha = 0.7) +
  # Add annotation for the dashed line (positioned on left, just after y-axis)
  annotate("text", 
           x = opo_order[2],  # Use second OPO (anonymized) to position further right
           y = overall_avg_pct + 2,  # Slightly above the line
           label = paste0("Overall Rate: ", round(overall_avg_pct, 1), "%"),
           size = 4,  # Larger text size
           family = "Helvetica",
           fontface = "italic",
           hjust = 0,  # Left-aligned so text starts at this position and continues right
           vjust = 0) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +  # Allow annotation outside plot area
  # Create bars: height = compliance percentage, color = AOOS orange
  geom_col(fill = GLOBAL_AOOS_COLOR, alpha = 0.9, width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "C",
    x = "OPO",
    y = "% of AOOS Accepted 4 Hours\nBefore Clamp or Later"
  ) +
  theme_gastro(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Helvetica", margin = margin(b = 8)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Helvetica"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Helvetica", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),  # Rotate OPO labels 90 degrees
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  # Set y-axis: 0-100% with breaks every 20%
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), 
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)))

print(p_aoos_compliance)
ggsave("figures/main/Figure6B_AOOS_Compliance_by_OPO.png", plot = p_aoos_compliance, width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Fig 6 combined: A+B on top, C below
p_figure6_combined <- (p1 + p1_prop) / p_aoos_compliance + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1), widths = c(1, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_figure6_combined)
ggsave("figures/main/Figure6_Combined.png", plot = p_figure6_combined, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

**Figure 6. Conditional Utilization Analysis and OPO Compliance with 4-Hour Threshold.**

At each time point on the x-axis we consider all organs that were **still unaccepted at that hour** (i.e., not yet accepted). That group includes organs later transplanted (at or after that time) and organs **never transplanted (discarded)**. We then ask: of that group, how many were ultimately utilized (A) and what percentage (B)? Total in analysis: `r scales::comma(total_accepted)` transplanted (AOOS: `r scales::comma(total_aoos_accepted)`, In-Sequence: `r scales::comma(total_sequential_accepted)`) and `r scales::comma(total_never_accepted)` never transplanted/discarded (AOOS: `r scales::comma(total_aoos_never_accepted)`, In-Sequence: `r scales::comma(total_sequential_never_accepted)`).

(A) At each time point, number of organs still unaccepted at that time that were ultimately transplanted, by allocation type.

(B) At each time point, utilization rate (%) among organs still unaccepted at that time. Denominator = all still unaccepted then (transplanted later + never transplanted). Vertical dashed line at -4 hours.

(C) Proportion of AOOS transplants accepted ≥4 hours pre-clamp by OPO, sorted by compliance rate (lowest to highest). Overall rate: `r round(overall_avg_pct, 1)`%. N = `r aoos_summary$total_aoos` total AOOS cases across `r nrow(aoos_by_opo)` OPOs.
