```{r machine-perfusion-prep, echo=FALSE}
# Build accepted_mp and discarded_mp for MP proportions table and timing figure
# (Previously created in deleted "Machine Perfusion and Utilization Timing" chunk)
accepted_mp <- timing_cohort %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, diff_final_clamp, is_open_offer,
           PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx, LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_original,
           LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_FDA_era) %>%
  mutate(
    hours_from_clamp = diff_final_clamp,
    allocation_type = if_else(is_open_offer, "AOOS", "Sequential"),
    seq_group = case_when(
      is_open_offer ~ "AOOS",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx < 50 ~ "<50 In-Sequence",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 50 ~ "≥50 In-Sequence",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MP_original = case_when(
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_original == "Y" ~ "Yes",
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_original == "N" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MP_extrapolated = case_when(
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_FDA_era == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION_FDA_era == "No" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    status = "Utilized"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(seq_group)) %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, .keep_all = TRUE)

if (!exists("donor_reduced")) {
  load(here("data_processed", "01_raw_data.rda"))
}

discarded_mp <- discarded_classified %>%
  left_join(
    donor_reduced %>%
      select(DONOR_ID, LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION) %>%
      distinct(DONOR_ID, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "DONOR_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MP_original = case_when(
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION == "Y" ~ "Yes",
      LI_MACHINE_PERFUSION == "N" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    status = "Discarded"
  )

donor_match_selection <- ptr_filtered %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE) %>%
  group_by(DONOR_ID) %>%
  arrange(desc(as.numeric(MATCH_ID_CODE))) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

discarded_sequential_seq <- discarded_mp %>%
  filter(allocation_type == "Sequential") %>%
  select(DONOR_ID) %>%
  left_join(donor_match_selection, by = "DONOR_ID") %>%
  left_join(
    ptr_filtered %>%
      group_by(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE) %>%
      summarise(seq_num = max(PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("DONOR_ID", "MATCH_ID_CODE")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    seq_group = case_when(
      !is.na(seq_num) & seq_num < 50 ~ "<50 In-Sequence",
      !is.na(seq_num) & seq_num >= 50 ~ "≥50 In-Sequence",
      TRUE ~ "In-Sequence"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(DONOR_ID, seq_group)

discarded_mp <- discarded_mp %>%
  mutate(
    seq_group = case_when(
      allocation_type == "AOOS" ~ "AOOS",
      TRUE ~ "In-Sequence"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(discarded_sequential_seq, by = "DONOR_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    seq_group = if_else(!is.na(seq_group.y), seq_group.y, seq_group.x)
  ) %>%
  select(-seq_group.x, -seq_group.y)
```

```{r machine-perfusion-proportions-table, echo=FALSE}
# MP proportions by allocation type and acceptance status

# never-accepted
never_accepted_props <- discarded_mp %>%
  filter(!is.na(MP_original), !is.na(seq_group)) %>%
  group_by(seq_group) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    With_MP = sum(MP_original == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Without_MP = sum(MP_original == "No", na.rm = TRUE),

    Pct_Without_MP = round(100 * Without_MP / Total, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Status = "Never-Accepted", MP_Definition = "Original")

# Accepted proportions (both definitions)

  filter(!is.na(MP_original), !is.na(seq_group)) %>%
  group_by(seq_group) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    With_MP = sum(MP_original == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Without_MP = sum(MP_original == "No", na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_With_MP = round(100 * With_MP / Total, 1),
    Pct_Without_MP = round(100 * Without_MP / Total, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Status = "Accepted", MP_Definition = "Original")

accepted_props_extrapolated <- accepted_mp %>%
  filter(!is.na(MP_extrapolated), !is.na(seq_group)) %>%
  group_by(seq_group) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    With_MP = sum(MP_extrapolated == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Without_MP = sum(MP_extrapolated == "No", na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_With_MP = round(100 * With_MP / Total, 1),
    Pct_Without_MP = round(100 * Without_MP / Total, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Status = "Accepted", MP_Definition = "Extrapolated")

# Combine all
props_table_data <- bind_rows(

) %>%

# Create formatted table

  gt() %>%
  tab_header(

  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Status = "Status",
    MP_Definition = "MP Definition",
    seq_group = "Allocation Type",
    Total = "Total N",
    With_MP = "With MP (N)",
    Pct_With_MP = "With MP (%)",
    Without_MP = "Without MP (N)",
    Pct_Without_MP = "Without MP (%)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Pct_With_MP, Pct_Without_MP), decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  )

props_table

# Save table
gtsave(props_table, here("figures", "supplement", "MP_Proportions_Table.html"))
gtsave(props_table, here("figures", "supplement", "MP_Proportions_Table.png"))

# Also save as CSV
write_csv(props_table_data, here("figures", "supplement", "MP_Proportions_Table.csv"))
```

**Supplemental Table. Machine Perfusion Use by Allocation Type and Acceptance Status.**

Proportions of organs using machine perfusion (MP) stratified by allocation type (<50 Accepted In-Sequence, ≥50 Accepted In-Sequence, AOOS) and acceptance status. Original definition reflects OPTN-coded machine perfusion. Extrapolated definition includes cases with recorded machine perfusion or cold ischemia time >12 hours in transplants occurring after FDA approval date (September 29, 2021) for accepted cases; never-accepted cases use original definition only.

## Supplemental Figure: Acceptance Timing Distribution by Machine Perfusion Status

```{r mp-timing-density, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# timing (diff_final_clamp) by MP vs non-MP, allocation type, MP definition

mp_timing_density <- accepted_mp %>%
  filter(!is.na(hours_from_clamp), !is.na(seq_group)) %>%
  select(DONOR_ID, seq_group, hours_from_clamp, MP_original, MP_extrapolated)

# Pivot longer to have one row per MP definition
mp_timing_long <- mp_timing_density %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(MP_original, MP_extrapolated),
    names_to = "MP_Definition",

  filter(!is.na(MP_status)) %>%
  mutate(
    MP_Definition = case_when(
      MP_Definition == "MP_original" ~ "OPTN Coded MP Definition",
      MP_Definition == "MP_extrapolated" ~ "Extrapolated MP Definition"
    ),
    MP_Definition = factor(MP_Definition, levels = c("OPTN Coded MP Definition", "Extrapolated MP Definition")),
    MP_status = factor(MP_status, levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    seq_group = factor(seq_group, levels = c("<50 In-Sequence", "≥50 In-Sequence", "AOOS"))
  )

# Create density plot

                        aes(x = hours_from_clamp, fill = MP_status, color = MP_status)) +

  ) +
  labs(

    y = "Density",
    title = "Distribution of Acceptance Timing by Machine Perfusion Status",
    subtitle = "Stratified by MP Definition (rows) and Allocation Type (columns)"

  theme_gastro() +

    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7)

print(p_mp_density)

# Save figure

  filename = here("figures", "supplement", "MP_Timing_Density.png"),
```

```{r figSF7-prep}
# Load center name lookups
ctr_unos <- read_csv("~center UNOS new.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
listing_center_names <- ctr_unos %>%
  select(LISTING_CTR_CODE, LISTING_CTR) %>%
  filter(!is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE)) %>%
  mutate(
    LISTING_CTR_clean = case_when(
      !is.na(LISTING_CTR) & LISTING_CTR != "" ~ LISTING_CTR,
      TRUE ~ LISTING_CTR_CODE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(LISTING_CTR_CODE) %>%
  summarise(LISTING_CTR = first(LISTING_CTR_clean), .groups = "drop")

# Load PTR data to calculate blanket refusals
load(here("data_processed", "01_raw_data.rda"))

# Get listing center codes
listing_center_codes <- liver_reduced %>%
  distinct(WL_ID_CODE, LISTING_CTR_CODE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE), !is.na(WL_ID_CODE))

# Panel 1: Count offers per OPO-Center pair
opo_center_counts_sf7 <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(

    ),

  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE_current) & !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE)) %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE = OPO_CTR_CODE_current, LISTING_CTR_CODE, offer_type) %>%
  summarise(n_offers = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    # Anonymize codes
    OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE),
    Center_anon = anonymize_center_vec(LISTING_CTR_CODE),
    pair_label = paste0(OPO_anon, " → ", Center_anon)
  )

# Panel 3: Calculate median proximity to clamp per OPO-Center pair
opo_center_timing_sf7 <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
      OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
      TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
    ),
    offer_type = ifelse(is_open_offer == TRUE, "AOOS", "Sequential")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE_current) & !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE) & !is.na(diff_final_clamp) &
    !is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & as.Date(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= TX_DATE
  ) %>%
  group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE = OPO_CTR_CODE_current, LISTING_CTR_CODE, offer_type) %>%
  summarise(median_time_to_clamp = median(diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    # Anonymize codes
    OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE),
    Center_anon = anonymize_center_vec(LISTING_CTR_CODE),
    pair_label = paste0(OPO_anon, " → ", Center_anon)
  )

# Get top 10 pairs by AOOS count
all_pairs_ordered_sf7 <- opo_center_counts_sf7 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = offer_type,
    values_from = n_offers,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  filter(AOOS > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(AOOS))

top_10_pairs_sf7 <- all_pairs_ordered_sf7 %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(pair_label)

# Find median reference: For each center, pick their highest AOOS OPO partner
one_pair_per_center_sf7 <- opo_center_counts_sf7 %>%
  filter(offer_type == "AOOS") %>%
  group_by(LISTING_CTR_CODE) %>%
  slice_max(n_offers, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(OPO_CTR_CODE, LISTING_CTR_CODE, OPO_anon, Center_anon, pair_label)

# Panel A: Median count across all one-pair-per-center pairs
median_center_counts_sf7 <- opo_center_counts_sf7 %>%
  inner_join(one_pair_per_center_sf7, by = c("OPO_CTR_CODE", "LISTING_CTR_CODE")) %>%
  group_by(offer_type) %>%
  summarise(n_offers = median(n_offers, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = n_offers, values_fill = 0)

# Panel B: Median time to clamp across all one-pair-per-center pairs
median_center_timing_sf7 <- opo_center_timing_sf7 %>%
  inner_join(one_pair_per_center_sf7, by = c("OPO_CTR_CODE", "LISTING_CTR_CODE")) %>%
  group_by(offer_type) %>%
  summarise(median_time_to_clamp = median(median_time_to_clamp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = median_time_to_clamp)

reference_label_sf7 <- "Median"

# Add median reference
if (!reference_label_sf7 %in% top_10_pairs_sf7) {
  opo_center_counts_sf7 <- opo_center_counts_sf7 %>%
    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        OPO_CTR_CODE = "MED",
        LISTING_CTR_CODE = "MED",
        offer_type = "AOOS",
        n_offers = ifelse(nrow(median_center_counts_sf7) > 0 && "AOOS" %in% names(median_center_counts_sf7), 
                         median_center_counts_sf7$AOOS[1], 0),
        pair_label = reference_label_sf7
      ),
      tibble(
        OPO_CTR_CODE = "MED",
        LISTING_CTR_CODE = "MED",
        offer_type = "Sequential",
        n_offers = ifelse(nrow(median_center_counts_sf7) > 0 && "Sequential" %in% names(median_center_counts_sf7), 
                         median_center_counts_sf7$Sequential[1], 0),
        pair_label = reference_label_sf7
      )
    )
  
  if (nrow(median_center_timing_sf7) > 0) {
    opo_center_timing_sf7 <- opo_center_timing_sf7 %>%
      bind_rows(
        tibble(
          OPO_CTR_CODE = "MED",
          LISTING_CTR_CODE = "MED",
          offer_type = "AOOS",
          median_time_to_clamp = ifelse("AOOS" %in% names(median_center_timing_sf7), 
                                       median_center_timing_sf7$AOOS[1], NA_real_),
          pair_label = reference_label_sf7
        ),
        tibble(
          OPO_CTR_CODE = "MED",
          LISTING_CTR_CODE = "MED",
          offer_type = "Sequential",
          median_time_to_clamp = ifelse("Sequential" %in% names(median_center_timing_sf7), 
                                       median_center_timing_sf7$Sequential[1], NA_real_),
          pair_label = reference_label_sf7
        )
      )
  }
}

if (!reference_label_sf7 %in% top_10_pairs_sf7) {
  top_pairs_labels_sf7 <- c(top_10_pairs_sf7, reference_label_sf7)
} else {
  top_pairs_labels_sf7 <- top_10_pairs_sf7
}
```

**Figure SF7. OPO-Center Relationships: Counts and Timing.** Top 10 OPO-Center pairs by number of AOOS (Allocation Out-of-Sequence) transplants, plus median reference (11th entry). The median reference was calculated by selecting, for each center, the OPO with which it had the highest AOOS count (one pair per center), then calculating medians across all those pairs for counts and proximity to clamp. All panels compare AOOS vs In-Sequence allocation types. Y-axis labels show OPO and Listing Center codes.

**(A) Raw counts (n) of transplants** for top 10 frequent OPO-Center pairs by AOOS count, plus median count across one-pair-per-center pairs (reference).

**(B) Median time from acceptance to cross-clamp** (hours; negative = pre-clamp, 0 = at clamp, positive = post-clamp). Each pair shows median for that specific pair; reference shows median across one-pair-per-center pairs. Shown as filled circles connected by lines.

```{r fig5-dcd-dbd-prep}
# Stratify Figure 5 analysis by donor type (DCD vs DBD)
# Hypothesis: OPOs that handle many DCDs should have higher AOOS rates and closer timing to clamp

# Identify Hawaii and Puerto Rico OPOs to exclude (not fair comparison due to geographic isolation)
# Load HRSA data to identify by state abbreviation
if (!exists("dsa") || !exists("opo_direct_mapping")) {
  # OPO mapping to HRSA codes
  opo_direct_mapping <- data.frame(
    OPO_CTR_CODE = c(
      "11346", "14167", "15376", "20243", "24986", "07657", "04433", "03720", "00527", "05239",
      "20429", "07006", "05952", "20491", "04743", "08897", "06696", "23002", "18879", "19282",

      "07843", "00093", "01209", "05611", "01054", "03441", "01116", "23870", "12865", "00217",
      "03348", "11377", "21979", "19809", "02139", "24614", "25581", "25172"
    ),
    OPO_PROVIDER_NUM = c(
      "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED",
      "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED",
      "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED",
      "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED",
      "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED",
      "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED"
    ),

# Identify Hawaii and Puerto Rico OPO codes
hi_pr_opo_codes <- dsa %>%
  filter(OPO_STATE_ABBR %in% c("HI", "PR")) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  left_join(opo_direct_mapping, by = "OPO_PROVIDER_NUM") %>%
  pull(OPO_CTR_CODE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

# Also handle merged codes (00527 -> 11036, etc.)
hi_pr_merged <- c()
if ("00527" %in% hi_pr_opo_codes) hi_pr_merged <- c(hi_pr_merged, "11036")
if ("05239" %in% hi_pr_opo_codes) hi_pr_merged <- c(hi_pr_merged, "14353")
if ("00093" %in% hi_pr_opo_codes) hi_pr_merged <- c(hi_pr_merged, "19282")
hi_pr_opo_codes_all <- unique(c(hi_pr_opo_codes, hi_pr_merged))

cat("Excluding Hawaii and Puerto Rico OPOs:", paste(hi_pr_opo_codes_all, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# Add donor type classification to timing_cohort
timing_cohort_with_type <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    donor_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(donor_type))

cat("=== FIGURE 5 STRATIFIED BY DONOR TYPE ===\n")
cat("Total cases with donor type:", nrow(timing_cohort_with_type), "\n")

cat("  DCD:", sum(timing_cohort_with_type$donor_type == "DCD"), "\n\n")

# Function to calculate top 10 pairs for a specific donor type
calculate_top_pairs_by_type <- function(data, donor_type_filter) {
  
  cat("=== Processing", donor_type_filter, "donors ===\n")
  
  # Filter to donor type
  data_filtered <- data %>%
    filter(donor_type == donor_type_filter)
  
  cat("N =", nrow(data_filtered), donor_type_filter, "cases\n")
  
  # OPO-center pairs (exclude HI/PR)
  opo_center_counts <- data_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
        TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
      ),
      offer_type = ifelse(is_open_offer == TRUE, "AOOS", "Sequential")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE_current) & !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE)) %>%
    filter(!OPO_CTR_CODE_current %in% hi_pr_opo_codes_all) %>%  # Exclude HI/PR
    group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE = OPO_CTR_CODE_current, LISTING_CTR_CODE, offer_type) %>%
    summarise(n_offers = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = n_offers, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      # Anonymize codes
      OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE),
      Center_anon = anonymize_center_vec(LISTING_CTR_CODE),
      pair_label = paste0(OPO_anon, " → ", Center_anon),
      total = AOOS + Sequential,
      aoos_rate = if_else(total > 0, 100 * AOOS / total, 0)
    )
  
  # one pair per center for median
  one_pair_per_center <- opo_center_counts %>%
    filter(AOOS > 0) %>%
    group_by(LISTING_CTR_CODE) %>%
    slice_max(AOOS, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  median_center_counts <- opo_center_counts %>%
    inner_join(one_pair_per_center %>% select(OPO_CTR_CODE, LISTING_CTR_CODE), 
               by = c("OPO_CTR_CODE", "LISTING_CTR_CODE")) %>%
    summarise(
      AOOS = median(AOOS, na.rm = TRUE),
      Sequential = median(Sequential, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  median_aoos <- ifelse(nrow(median_center_counts) > 0, median_center_counts$AOOS[1], 0)
  median_seq <- ifelse(nrow(median_center_counts) > 0, median_center_counts$Sequential[1], 0)
  
  cat("Median AOOS count (for filtering):", median_aoos, "\n")
  cat("Median In-Sequence count (for filtering):", median_seq, "\n")
  
  # above-median pairs, top 10 by AOOS rate
  above_median_pairs <- opo_center_counts %>%
    filter(AOOS > median_aoos & Sequential > median_seq) %>%
    arrange(desc(aoos_rate))
  
  top_10_pairs <- above_median_pairs %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    pull(pair_label)
  
  # Calculate median rate using one-pair-per-center
  median_pair_rate <- median(one_pair_per_center$aoos_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
  median_pair_counts <- one_pair_per_center %>%
    summarise(
      median_aoos = median(AOOS, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_sequential = median(Sequential, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  cat("Top 10 pairs by AOOS rate:\n")
  print(above_median_pairs %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% 
        select(pair_label, AOOS, Sequential, total, aoos_rate))
  cat("\nMedian pair rate:", round(median_pair_rate, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Median AOOS:", median_pair_counts$median_aoos, "\n")
  cat("Median In-Sequence:", median_pair_counts$median_sequential, "\n\n")
  
  # Prepare count data for plotting
  pair_counts_plot <- above_median_pairs %>%
    filter(pair_label %in% top_10_pairs) %>%
    select(pair_label, AOOS, Sequential) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(AOOS, Sequential), names_to = "offer_type", values_to = "n_offers") %>%
    mutate(pair_label_fct = factor(pair_label, levels = rev(top_10_pairs)))
  
  # Prepare rate labels
  pair_rates_labels <- above_median_pairs %>%
    filter(pair_label %in% top_10_pairs) %>%
    select(pair_label, aoos_rate) %>%
    mutate(
      pair_label_fct = factor(pair_label, levels = rev(top_10_pairs)),
      rate_label = paste0(round(aoos_rate, 1), "%")
    )
  
  # Add median reference
  reference_label <- "Median"
  
  pair_counts_plot <- pair_counts_plot %>%
    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        pair_label = "MED",
        pair_label_fct = factor(reference_label, levels = c(reference_label, rev(top_10_pairs))),
        offer_type = "AOOS",
        n_offers = median_pair_counts$median_aoos
      ),
      tibble(
        pair_label = "MED",
        pair_label_fct = factor(reference_label, levels = c(reference_label, rev(top_10_pairs))),
        offer_type = "Sequential",
        n_offers = median_pair_counts$median_sequential
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(pair_label_fct = factor(pair_label_fct, levels = c(reference_label, rev(top_10_pairs))))
  
  pair_rates_labels <- pair_rates_labels %>%
    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        pair_label = "MED",
        pair_label_fct = factor(reference_label, levels = c(reference_label, rev(top_10_pairs))),
        aoos_rate = median_pair_rate,
        rate_label = paste0(round(median_pair_rate, 1), "%")
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(pair_label_fct = factor(pair_label_fct, levels = c(reference_label, rev(top_10_pairs))))
  
  # Calculate timing data
  # EXCLUDE Hawaii and Puerto Rico OPOs
  pair_timing <- data_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
        TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
      ),
      offer_type = ifelse(is_open_offer == TRUE, "AOOS", "Sequential"),
      # Anonymize codes
      OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE_current),
      Center_anon = anonymize_center_vec(LISTING_CTR_CODE),
      pair_label = paste0(OPO_anon, " → ", Center_anon)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE_current) & !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE) & !is.na(diff_final_clamp) &
      !is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & as.Date(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= TX_DATE &
      pair_label %in% top_10_pairs &
      !OPO_CTR_CODE_current %in% hi_pr_opo_codes_all  # Exclude HI/PR
    ) %>%
    group_by(pair_label, offer_type) %>%
    summarise(median_time_to_clamp = median(diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pair_label_fct = factor(pair_label, levels = c(reference_label, rev(top_10_pairs))))
  
  # Calculate median timing reference
  # EXCLUDE Hawaii and Puerto Rico OPOs
  median_pair_timing <- data_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      OPO_CTR_CODE_current = case_when(
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
        TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
      ),
      offer_type = ifelse(is_open_offer == TRUE, "AOOS", "Sequential"),
      # Anonymize codes
      OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE_current),
      Center_anon = anonymize_center_vec(LISTING_CTR_CODE),
      pair_label = paste0(OPO_anon, " → ", Center_anon)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE_current) & !is.na(LISTING_CTR_CODE) & !is.na(diff_final_clamp) &
      !is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) & as.Date(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= TX_DATE &
      !OPO_CTR_CODE_current %in% hi_pr_opo_codes_all  # Exclude HI/PR
    ) %>%
    inner_join(one_pair_per_center %>% select(OPO_CTR_CODE, LISTING_CTR_CODE),
               by = c("OPO_CTR_CODE_current" = "OPO_CTR_CODE", "LISTING_CTR_CODE" = "LISTING_CTR_CODE")) %>%
    group_by(pair_label, offer_type) %>%
    summarise(median_time_to_clamp = median(diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(offer_type) %>%
    summarise(median_time_to_clamp = median(median_time_to_clamp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add median timing reference
  pair_timing <- pair_timing %>%
    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        pair_label = "MED",
        pair_label_fct = factor(reference_label, levels = c(reference_label, rev(top_10_pairs))),
        offer_type = "AOOS",
        median_time_to_clamp = ifelse("AOOS" %in% median_pair_timing$offer_type,
                                     median_pair_timing$median_time_to_clamp[median_pair_timing$offer_type == "AOOS"],
                                     NA_real_)
      ),
      tibble(
        pair_label = "MED",
        pair_label_fct = factor(reference_label, levels = c(reference_label, rev(top_10_pairs))),
        offer_type = "Sequential",
        median_time_to_clamp = ifelse("Sequential" %in% median_pair_timing$offer_type,
                                     median_pair_timing$median_time_to_clamp[median_pair_timing$offer_type == "Sequential"],
                                     NA_real_)
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(pair_label_fct = factor(pair_label_fct, levels = c(reference_label, rev(top_10_pairs))))
  
  return(list(
    counts = pair_counts_plot,
    rates = pair_rates_labels,
    timing = pair_timing,
    donor_type = donor_type_filter
  ))
}
```

```{r fig5-stratified-stats}
# Print statistics for writing paragraph - DBD and DCD separately

print_donor_type_stats <- function(donor_type_label, pairs_data, timing_data, rates_data) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("STATISTICS FOR", donor_type_label, "DONORS\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n\n")
  
  # Get counts data
  counts_wide <- pairs_data$counts %>%
    filter(pair_label_fct != "Median") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = n_offers, id_cols = pair_label_fct)
  
  # Median stats (from all pairs with at least 1 AOOS)
  median_row <- pairs_data$counts %>% filter(pair_label_fct == "Median")
  median_aoos_count <- median_row %>% filter(offer_type == "AOOS") %>% pull(n_offers)
  median_seq_count <- median_row %>% filter(offer_type == "Sequential") %>% pull(n_offers)
  
  cat("--- MEDIAN STATISTICS (across all pairs with ≥1 AOOS) ---\n")
  cat("Median AOOS count:", median_aoos_count, "\n")
  cat("Median In-Sequence count:", median_seq_count, "\n\n")
  
  # Median timing
  median_timing_row <- pairs_data$timing %>% filter(pair_label_fct == "Median")
  median_aoos_timing <- median_timing_row %>% filter(offer_type == "AOOS") %>% pull(median_time_to_clamp)
  median_seq_timing <- median_timing_row %>% filter(offer_type == "Sequential") %>% pull(median_time_to_clamp)
  timing_diff <- median_aoos_timing - median_seq_timing
  
  cat("Median AOOS timing (hours from clamp):", round(median_aoos_timing, 2), "\n")
  cat("Median In-Sequence timing (hours from clamp):", round(median_seq_timing, 2), "\n")
  cat("AOOS accepted", round(abs(timing_diff), 1), "hours", 
      ifelse(timing_diff > 0, "LATER", "EARLIER"), "than In-Sequence\n\n")
  
  # Top 10 pairs statistics
  cat("--- TOP 10 PAIRS (above median, ranked by AOOS rate) ---\n")
  top10_pairs <- pairs_data$counts %>%
    filter(pair_label_fct != "Median") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = n_offers, id_cols = pair_label_fct)
  
  top10_rates <- pairs_data$rates %>%
    filter(pair_label_fct != "Median")
  
  cat("AOOS rate range:", 
      round(min(top10_rates$aoos_rate) * 100, 1), "% to", 
      round(max(top10_rates$aoos_rate) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  
  # Get overall median rate from rates
  overall_median_rate <- pairs_data$rates %>% 
    filter(pair_label_fct == "Median") %>% 
    pull(aoos_rate)
  cat("Overall median AOOS rate:", round(overall_median_rate * 100, 1), "%\n\n")
  
  # Top 10 timing
  top10_timing <- pairs_data$timing %>%
    filter(pair_label_fct != "Median")
  
  top10_aoos_timing <- top10_timing %>% filter(offer_type == "AOOS") %>% pull(median_time_to_clamp)
  top10_seq_timing <- top10_timing %>% filter(offer_type == "Sequential") %>% pull(median_time_to_clamp)
  
  median_top10_aoos_timing <- median(top10_aoos_timing, na.rm = TRUE)
  median_top10_seq_timing <- median(top10_seq_timing, na.rm = TRUE)
  top10_timing_diff <- median_top10_aoos_timing - median_top10_seq_timing
  
  cat("In top 10 pairs:\n")
  cat("  Median AOOS timing:", round(median_top10_aoos_timing, 2), "hours from clamp\n")
  cat("  Median In-Sequence timing:", round(median_top10_seq_timing, 2), "hours from clamp\n")
  cat("  AOOS accepted", round(abs(top10_timing_diff), 1), "hours",
      ifelse(top10_timing_diff > 0, "LATER", "EARLIER"), "than In-Sequence\n\n")
  
  # Print the top 10 pairs table
  cat("--- TOP 10 PAIRS DETAILS ---\n")
  top10_details <- pairs_data$counts %>%
    filter(pair_label_fct != "Median") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = n_offers, id_cols = pair_label_fct) %>%
    left_join(pairs_data$rates %>% select(pair_label_fct, aoos_rate), by = "pair_label_fct") %>%
    left_join(
      pairs_data$timing %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = median_time_to_clamp, 
                    id_cols = pair_label_fct, names_prefix = "timing_"),
      by = "pair_label_fct"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      aoos_rate_pct = round(aoos_rate * 100, 1),
      timing_AOOS = round(timing_AOOS, 2),
      timing_Sequential = round(timing_Sequential, 2)
    )
  
  print(top10_details %>% select(pair_label_fct, AOOS, Sequential, aoos_rate_pct, timing_AOOS, timing_Sequential))
  cat("\n")
}

# Print DBD statistics
print_donor_type_stats("DBD", dbd_pairs, dbd_pairs$timing, dbd_pairs$rates)

# Print DCD statistics
print_donor_type_stats("DCD", dcd_pairs, dcd_pairs$timing, dcd_pairs$rates)
```

**Figure 5 Stratified. OPO-Center Pair Analysis by AOOS Rate: Stratified by Donor Type (DBD vs DCD).** Top 10 OPO-Center pairs ranked by AOOS (Allocation Out-of-Sequence) rate, separately for DBD donors (Panels A-B) and DCD donors (Panels C-D). For each donor type, pairs were selected from those exceeding median thresholds for both AOOS and In-Sequence counts, then ranked by AOOS rate. Median reference (11th entry) represents the median across above-median pairs for each donor type. All panels compare AOOS vs In-Sequence allocation types. Y-axis labels show OPO and Listing Center codes.

**(A) DBD donors: Raw counts (n) of transplants** for top 10 OPO-Center pairs by AOOS rate (from above-median pairs), plus median count across above-median pairs (reference).

**(B) DBD donors: Median time from acceptance to cross-clamp** (hours; negative = pre-clamp, 0 = at clamp, positive = post-clamp). Each pair shows median for that specific pair; reference shows median across above-median pairs. Shown as filled circles connected by lines.

**(C) DCD donors: Raw counts (n) of transplants** for top 10 OPO-Center pairs by AOOS rate (from above-median pairs), plus median count across above-median pairs (reference).

**(D) DCD donors: Median time from acceptance to cross-clamp** (hours; negative = pre-clamp, 0 = at clamp, positive = post-clamp). Each pair shows median for that specific pair; reference shows median across above-median pairs. Shown as filled circles connected by lines.

```{r fig6-dcd-dbd-prep}
# Stratify Figure 6 (utilization timing) by donor type
# All 3 panels (counts, proportions, OPO compliance) for DBD and DCD separately

cat("=== FIGURE 6 STRATIFIED BY DONOR TYPE ===\n\n")

# AOOS identification constants
if (!exists("OPEN_OFFER_BYPASS_CODES")) {
  OPEN_OFFER_BYPASS_CODES <- c(861L, 862L, 863L, 887L, 888L, 760L, 761L, 762L, 763L, 764L, 765L)
  OPEN_OFFER_TEXT_CODES <- c(798L, 799L, 898L)
  OPEN_OFFER_TEXT_PATTERN <- regex("expedited|open offer|aggressive", ignore_case = TRUE)
}

# accepted with donor type (timing_cohort)
accepted_with_type <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    donor_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(donor_type)) %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, diff_final_clamp, is_open_offer, donor_type) %>%
  mutate(
    hours_from_clamp = diff_final_clamp,
    allocation_type = if_else(is_open_offer, "AOOS", "Sequential"),
    status = "Utilized"
  ) %>%
  select(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, hours_from_clamp, allocation_type, status, donor_type)

# discarded with donor type
if (!exists("ptr_reduced")) {
  load(here("data_processed", "01_raw_data.rda"))
}

# Filter PTR to study period
ptr_filtered_fig6 <- ptr_reduced %>%
  filter(!is.na(MATCH_DATE), as.Date(MATCH_DATE) >= as.Date("2021-12-09"))

# Get all donors and transplanted donors
all_donors_ptr_fig6 <- ptr_filtered_fig6 %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID)

transplanted_donors_fig6 <- liver_reduced %>%
  filter(!is.na(TX_DATE), !is.na(DONOR_ID)) %>%
  distinct(DONOR_ID)

# Discarded donors
discarded_donors_fig6 <- all_donors_ptr_fig6 %>%
  filter(!DONOR_ID %in% transplanted_donors_fig6$DONOR_ID)

cat("Total PTR donors:", nrow(all_donors_ptr_fig6), "\n")
cat("Transplanted:", nrow(transplanted_donors_fig6), "\n")
cat("Discarded:", nrow(discarded_donors_fig6), "\n")

# Add MATCH_ID_CODE for compatibility with existing code
discarded_classified_fig6 <- discarded_complete %>%
  mutate(MATCH_ID_CODE = DONOR_ID) %>%
  select(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, allocation_type, status, donor_type)

cat("Discarded with complete data (from standardized dataset):", nrow(discarded_classified_fig6), "\n")

cat("  DCD:", sum(discarded_classified_fig6$donor_type == "DCD"), "\n\n")

# Function to calculate utilization at each time point for a specific donor type
calculate_utilization_by_type <- function(donor_type_filter) {
  
  cat("=== Processing", donor_type_filter, "donors ===\n")
  
  # Filter accepted and discarded to this donor type
  accepted_type <- accepted_with_type %>%
    filter(donor_type == donor_type_filter)
  
  discarded_type <- discarded_classified_fig6 %>%
    filter(donor_type == donor_type_filter)
  
  cat("Accepted:", nrow(accepted_type), "\n")
  cat("Discarded:", nrow(discarded_type), "\n")
  
  # Totals by allocation type
  total_accepted <- n_distinct(accepted_type$DONOR_ID)
  total_discarded <- nrow(discarded_type)
  total_aoos_accepted <- n_distinct(accepted_type$DONOR_ID[accepted_type$allocation_type == "AOOS"])
  total_aoos_discarded <- sum(discarded_type$allocation_type == "AOOS", na.rm = TRUE)
  total_seq_accepted <- n_distinct(accepted_type$DONOR_ID[accepted_type$allocation_type == "Sequential"])
  total_seq_discarded <- sum(discarded_type$allocation_type == "Sequential", na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat("  AOOS: Accepted =", total_aoos_accepted, ", Discarded =", total_aoos_discarded, "\n")
  cat("  In-Sequence: Accepted =", total_seq_accepted, ", Discarded =", total_seq_discarded, "\n\n")
  
  # Define time points
  cutoff_hours_range <- seq(-24, 24, by = 2)
  cutoff_hours_with_labels <- seq(-24, 4, by = 4)
  
  # Calculate utilization at each cutoff
  calculate_at_cutoff <- function(cutoff_hr) {
    accepted_at_cutoff <- accepted_type %>%
      filter(hours_from_clamp >= cutoff_hr)
    
    combined <- bind_rows(
      accepted_at_cutoff %>%
        distinct(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status) %>%
        select(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status),
      discarded_type %>%
        select(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status)
    )
    
    summary <- combined %>%
      filter(!is.na(allocation_type)) %>%
      group_by(allocation_type, status) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
    if (!"Utilized" %in% names(summary)) summary$Utilized <- 0L
    if (!"Discarded" %in% names(summary)) summary$Discarded <- 0L
    summary <- summary %>%
      mutate(
        cutoff_hours = cutoff_hr,
        Total = Utilized + Discarded,
        Pct_Utilized = if_else(Total > 0, 100 * Utilized / Total, 0)
      ) %>%
      select(cutoff_hours, allocation_type, Utilized, Discarded, Total, Pct_Utilized)

    return(summary)
  }

  results <- map_dfr(cutoff_hours_range, calculate_at_cutoff)

  # Add label flag and proportion still unaccepted (KM-style: final % = discarded)
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(show_label = cutoff_hours %in% cutoff_hours_with_labels)

  # Proportion still unaccepted: 100 * Total / initial_total per allocation_type
  plot_data <- results %>%
    group_by(allocation_type) %>%
    mutate(initial_total = max(Total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Pct_still_unaccepted = if_else(initial_total > 0, 100 * Total / initial_total, NA_real_),
      x_position = cutoff_hours,
      label_text = if_else(show_label, paste0(round(Pct_Utilized, 1), "%"), "")
    )
  
  return(list(
    data = plot_data,
    donor_type = donor_type_filter,
    totals = list(
      total_accepted = total_accepted,
      total_discarded = total_discarded,
      total_aoos_accepted = total_aoos_accepted,
      total_aoos_discarded = total_aoos_discarded,
      total_seq_accepted = total_seq_accepted,
      total_seq_discarded = total_seq_discarded
    )
  ))
}

# Calculate for DBD and DCD
dbd_utilization <- calculate_utilization_by_type("DBD")
dcd_utilization <- calculate_utilization_by_type("DCD")
```

```{r fig6-dcd-dbd-panel-c, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
        "20429", "07006", "05952", "20491", "04743", "08897", "06696", "23002", "18879", "19282",
        "24149", "11036", "14353", "09331", "01519", "11811", "10447", "12617", "08773", "14911",
        "02821", "22847", "08866", "15655", "15903", "22661", "14012", "17639", "03782", "25389",
        "07843", "00093", "01209", "05611", "01054", "03441", "01116", "23870", "12865", "00217",
        "03348", "11377", "21979", "19809", "02139", "24614", "25581", "25172"
      ),

        "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED",

        "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED",
        "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED", "REDACTED"
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    base <- "https://gisportal.hrsa.gov/server/rest/services/Organs/OrganProcurementAndTransplantation_FS/MapServer/3/query"
    url <- paste0(base, "?where=1=1", "&outFields=OPO_PROVIDER_NUM,OPO_PROVIDER_NM,OPO_STATE_ABBR", "&outSR=4326", "&f=geojson")
    dsa <- st_read(url, quiet = TRUE)
  }
  hi_pr_opo_codes <- dsa %>%
    filter(OPO_STATE_ABBR %in% c("HI", "PR")) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(opo_direct_mapping, by = "OPO_PROVIDER_NUM") %>%
    pull(OPO_CTR_CODE) %>%
    unique() %>%
    na.omit()
  hi_pr_merged <- c()
  if ("00527" %in% hi_pr_opo_codes) hi_pr_merged <- c(hi_pr_merged, "11036")
  if ("05239" %in% hi_pr_opo_codes) hi_pr_merged <- c(hi_pr_merged, "14353")
  if ("00093" %in% hi_pr_opo_codes) hi_pr_merged <- c(hi_pr_merged, "19282")
  hi_pr_opo_codes_all <- unique(c(hi_pr_opo_codes, hi_pr_merged))
}

# Function to calculate OPO compliance by donor type
calculate_opo_compliance_by_type <- function(donor_type_filter) {
  
  # Filter accepted to donor type and AOOS only
  accepted_type <- accepted_with_type %>%
    filter(donor_type == donor_type_filter & allocation_type == "AOOS")
  
  # Join with timing_cohort to get OPO codes
  compliance_data <- accepted_type %>%
    inner_join(timing_cohort %>% 
                 select(DONOR_ID, MATCH_ID_CODE, OPO_CTR_CODE, diff_final_clamp),
               by = c("DONOR_ID", "MATCH_ID_CODE")) %>%
    mutate(
      OPO_CTR_CODE = case_when(
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "00527" ~ "11036",
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "05239" ~ "14353",
        OPO_CTR_CODE == "00093" ~ "19282",
        TRUE ~ OPO_CTR_CODE
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(OPO_CTR_CODE)) %>%
    filter(!OPO_CTR_CODE %in% hi_pr_opo_codes_all)  # EXCLUDE Hawaii and Puerto Rico
  
  # Calculate compliance per OPO
  opo_compliance <- compliance_data %>%
    group_by(OPO_CTR_CODE) %>%
    summarise(
      n_aoos = n(),
      n_meets_criterion = sum(diff_final_clamp >= -4, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_meets_criterion = 100 * n_meets_criterion / n_aoos,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_aoos >= 5) %>%  # Minimum threshold
    arrange(pct_meets_criterion, OPO_CTR_CODE)  # Sort by compliance (low to high), then OPO for deterministic order
  
  # Overall average (EXCLUDING Hawaii and Puerto Rico)
  overall_avg <- compliance_data %>%
    summarise(
      n_aoos = n(),
      n_meets_criterion = sum(diff_final_clamp >= -4, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_meets_criterion = 100 * n_meets_criterion / n_aoos
    )
  
  # Anonymize OPO codes and convert to factor with levels in exact display order (row order = compliance order)
  opo_compliance <- opo_compliance %>%
    mutate(OPO_anon = anonymize_opo_vec(OPO_CTR_CODE))
  
  # unique() preserves order of first occurrence; needed if same OPO_anon appears more than once
  opo_order <- unique(opo_compliance$OPO_anon)
  opo_compliance <- opo_compliance %>%
    mutate(OPO_anon = factor(OPO_anon, levels = opo_order))
  
  return(list(
    data = opo_compliance,
    overall_avg = overall_avg$pct_meets_criterion,
    overall_n_meets = overall_avg$n_meets_criterion,
    overall_n_total = overall_avg$n_aoos,
    donor_type = donor_type_filter
  ))
}
```

```{r fig6-stratified-stats}
# Print raw numbers for Figure 6 stratified by donor type - for writing results

print_fig6_stats <- function(util_data, donor_type_label) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("FIGURE 6 RAW DATA FOR", donor_type_label, "DONORS\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n\n")
  
  # Print totals
  totals <- util_data$totals
  cat("--- OVERALL TOTALS ---\n")
  cat("Total accepted:", totals$total_accepted, "\n")
  cat("Total discarded:", totals$total_discarded, "\n")
  cat("  AOOS: Accepted =", totals$total_aoos_accepted, ", Discarded =", totals$total_aoos_discarded, "\n")
  cat("  In-Sequence: Accepted =", totals$total_seq_accepted, ", Discarded =", totals$total_seq_discarded, "\n\n")
  
  # Print utilization at key time points
  cat("--- UTILIZATION AT KEY TIME POINTS ---\n")
  
  key_hours <- c(-24, -20, -16, -12, -8, -4, 0, 4)
  
  key_data <- util_data$data %>%
    filter(cutoff_hours %in% key_hours) %>%
    select(cutoff_hours, allocation_type, Utilized, Discarded, Total, Pct_Utilized) %>%
    arrange(cutoff_hours, allocation_type)
  
  # Wide format for easier reading
  key_data_wide <- key_data %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = cutoff_hours,
      names_from = allocation_type,
      values_from = c(Utilized, Discarded, Total, Pct_Utilized)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Pct_Utilized_AOOS = round(Pct_Utilized_AOOS, 1),
      Pct_Utilized_Sequential = round(Pct_Utilized_Sequential, 1)
    )
  
  cat("\nCutoff_Hr | AOOS Util | AOOS Disc | AOOS Total | AOOS % | SEQ Util | SEQ Disc | SEQ Total | SEQ %\n")
  cat(paste(rep("-", 110), collapse = ""), "\n")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(key_data_wide)) {
    row <- key_data_wide[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("%9d | %9d | %9d | %10d | %6.1f | %8d | %8d | %9d | %5.1f\n",
                row$cutoff_hours,
                row$Utilized_AOOS, row$Discarded_AOOS, row$Total_AOOS, row$Pct_Utilized_AOOS,
                row$Utilized_Sequential, row$Discarded_Sequential, row$Total_Sequential, row$Pct_Utilized_Sequential))
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  
  # Print full data table for copy-paste
  cat("--- FULL DATA TABLE (all time points) ---\n")
  full_table <- util_data$data %>%
    select(cutoff_hours, allocation_type, Utilized, Discarded, Total, Pct_Utilized) %>%
    mutate(Pct_Utilized = round(Pct_Utilized, 1)) %>%
    arrange(cutoff_hours, allocation_type)
  
  print(full_table, n = Inf)
  cat("\n")
}

# Print DBD statistics
print_fig6_stats(dbd_utilization, "DBD")

# Print DCD statistics  
print_fig6_stats(dcd_utilization, "DCD")

# Print 4-hour threshold compliance statistics for DBD and DCD
print_compliance_stats <- function(compliance_data, donor_type_label) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("4-HOUR THRESHOLD COMPLIANCE STATISTICS FOR", donor_type_label, "DONORS\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n\n")
  
  data <- compliance_data$data
  overall_avg <- compliance_data$overall_avg
  overall_n_meets <- compliance_data$overall_n_meets
  overall_n_total <- compliance_data$overall_n_total
  
  cat("--- OVERALL COMPLIANCE ---\n")
  cat("Overall rate:", round(overall_avg, 1), "% of AOOS cases met the 4-hour pre-clamp threshold\n")
  cat("Raw counts:", format(overall_n_meets, big.mark = ","), "/", 
      format(overall_n_total, big.mark = ","), 
      "(cases meeting threshold / total AOOS cases)\n\n")
  
  # Distribution across OPOs by threshold ranges
  cat("--- DISTRIBUTION ACROSS OPOs ---\n")
  n_90plus <- sum(data$pct_meets_criterion >= 90)
  n_80_89 <- sum(data$pct_meets_criterion >= 80 & data$pct_meets_criterion < 90)
  n_70_79 <- sum(data$pct_meets_criterion >= 70 & data$pct_meets_criterion < 80)
  n_60_69 <- sum(data$pct_meets_criterion >= 60 & data$pct_meets_criterion < 70)
  n_below60 <- sum(data$pct_meets_criterion < 60)
  
  cat("OPOs with ≥90% compliance:", n_90plus, "\n")
  cat("OPOs with 80-89% compliance:", n_80_89, "\n")
  cat("OPOs with 70-79% compliance:", n_70_79, "\n")
  cat("OPOs with 60-69% compliance:", n_60_69, "\n")
  cat("OPOs with <60% compliance:", n_below60, "\n")
  cat("Total OPOs:", nrow(data), "\n\n")
  
  # Min/max stats
  cat("--- RANGE ---\n")
  cat("Highest compliance OPO:", data$OPO_anon[which.max(data$pct_meets_criterion)], 
      "at", round(max(data$pct_meets_criterion), 1), "%\n")
  cat("Lowest compliance OPO:", data$OPO_anon[which.min(data$pct_meets_criterion)], 
      "at", round(min(data$pct_meets_criterion), 1), "%\n\n")
  
  # Full table (using anonymized codes)
  cat("--- FULL OPO COMPLIANCE TABLE ---\n")
  print(data %>% 
          select(OPO_anon, n_aoos, n_meets_criterion, pct_meets_criterion) %>%
          mutate(pct_meets_criterion = round(pct_meets_criterion, 1)) %>%
          arrange(desc(pct_meets_criterion)), 
        n = Inf)
  cat("\n")
}

# Print DBD compliance statistics
print_compliance_stats(dbd_compliance, "DBD")

# Print DCD compliance statistics
print_compliance_stats(dcd_compliance, "DCD")
```

Utilization timing and OPO compliance by donor type.** The proportion still unaccepted uses 24 hours before cross-clamp as the baseline (time 0) for the denominator, because match runs could otherwise extend indefinitely and earlier time points are not practical or meaningful to evaluate. Non-transplanted match runs include all donors who entered the match system but whose liver was not transplanted (whether or not the organ was recovered). (A) DBD donors: count still unaccepted at each time point that were ultimately utilized. (B) DBD donors: proportion still unaccepted over time; final % = non-transplanted match runs: In-Sequence `r round(dbd_final_pct$Pct_still_unaccepted[dbd_final_pct$allocation_type=="Sequential"], 1)`% (n=`r scales::comma(dbd_final_pct$Discarded[dbd_final_pct$allocation_type=="Sequential"])`), AOOS `r round(dbd_final_pct$Pct_still_unaccepted[dbd_final_pct$allocation_type=="AOOS"], 1)`% (n=`r scales::comma(dbd_final_pct$Discarded[dbd_final_pct$allocation_type=="AOOS"])`). (C) DCD donors: count still unaccepted at each time point that were ultimately utilized. (D) DCD donors: proportion still unaccepted over time; final % = non-transplanted match runs: In-Sequence `r round(dcd_final_pct$Pct_still_unaccepted[dcd_final_pct$allocation_type=="Sequential"], 1)`% (n=`r scales::comma(dcd_final_pct$Discarded[dcd_final_pct$allocation_type=="Sequential"])`), AOOS `r round(dcd_final_pct$Pct_still_unaccepted[dcd_final_pct$allocation_type=="AOOS"], 1)`% (n=`r scales::comma(dcd_final_pct$Discarded[dcd_final_pct$allocation_type=="AOOS"])`). (E-F) OPO compliance with 4-hour threshold for DBD and DCD respectively. Dashed vertical line at -4 hours represents the threshold; dashed horizontal line shows overall average compliance.

```{r fig6-recovered-discard-prep}
# Same function as calculate_utilization_by_type but accepts custom discarded data
calculate_utilization_by_type_recovered <- function(donor_type_filter) {
  
  cat("=== Processing", donor_type_filter, "donors (recovered-only discards) ===\n")
  
  # Accepted: same as before (from accepted_with_type already defined)
  accepted_type <- accepted_with_type %>%
    filter(donor_type == donor_type_filter)
  
  # Discarded: recovered-only subset
  discarded_type <- discarded_recovered_fig6 %>%
    filter(donor_type == donor_type_filter)
  
  cat("Accepted:", nrow(accepted_type), "\n")
  cat("Recovered-only discards:", nrow(discarded_type), "\n")
  
  total_accepted <- n_distinct(accepted_type$DONOR_ID)
  total_discarded <- nrow(discarded_type)
  total_aoos_accepted <- n_distinct(accepted_type$DONOR_ID[accepted_type$allocation_type == "AOOS"])
  total_aoos_discarded <- sum(discarded_type$allocation_type == "AOOS", na.rm = TRUE)
  total_seq_accepted <- n_distinct(accepted_type$DONOR_ID[accepted_type$allocation_type == "Sequential"])
  total_seq_discarded <- sum(discarded_type$allocation_type == "Sequential", na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat("  AOOS: Accepted =", total_aoos_accepted, ", Discarded =", total_aoos_discarded, "\n")
  cat("  In-Sequence: Accepted =", total_seq_accepted, ", Discarded =", total_seq_discarded, "\n\n")
  
  cutoff_hours_range <- seq(-24, 24, by = 2)
  cutoff_hours_with_labels <- seq(-24, 4, by = 4)
  
  calculate_at_cutoff <- function(cutoff_hr) {
    accepted_at_cutoff <- accepted_type %>%
      filter(hours_from_clamp >= cutoff_hr)
    
    combined <- bind_rows(
      accepted_at_cutoff %>%
        distinct(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status) %>%
        select(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status),
      discarded_type %>%
        select(DONOR_ID, allocation_type, status)
    )
    
    summary <- combined %>%
      filter(!is.na(allocation_type)) %>%
      group_by(allocation_type, status) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
    if (!"Utilized" %in% names(summary)) summary$Utilized <- 0L
    if (!"Discarded" %in% names(summary)) summary$Discarded <- 0L
    summary <- summary %>%
      mutate(
        cutoff_hours = cutoff_hr,
        Total = Utilized + Discarded,
        Pct_Utilized = if_else(Total > 0, 100 * Utilized / Total, 0)
      ) %>%
      select(cutoff_hours, allocation_type, Utilized, Discarded, Total, Pct_Utilized)
    
    return(summary)
  }
  
  results <- map_dfr(cutoff_hours_range, calculate_at_cutoff)
  
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(show_label = cutoff_hours %in% cutoff_hours_with_labels)
  
  plot_data <- results %>%
    group_by(allocation_type) %>%
    mutate(initial_total = max(Total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Pct_still_unaccepted = if_else(initial_total > 0, 100 * Total / initial_total, NA_real_),
      x_position = cutoff_hours,
      label_text = if_else(show_label, paste0(round(Pct_Utilized, 1), "%"), "")
    )
  
  return(list(
    data = plot_data,
    donor_type = donor_type_filter,
    totals = list(
      total_accepted = total_accepted,
      total_discarded = total_discarded,
      total_aoos_accepted = total_aoos_accepted,
      total_aoos_discarded = total_aoos_discarded,
      total_seq_accepted = total_seq_accepted,
      total_seq_discarded = total_seq_discarded
    )
  ))
}

dbd_util_recovered <- calculate_utilization_by_type_recovered("DBD")
dcd_util_recovered <- calculate_utilization_by_type_recovered("DCD")
```

```{r supp-dri-dsri-accepted, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
# DRI and DSRI density curves for accepted transplants only, by sequence group.
# Two panels: (A) DRI, (B) DSRI. N with complete data printed at bottom for supplement.
sequence_colors_supp <- c(
  "<50 sequence" = "#0066CC",
  "≥50 sequence" = "#00468B",
  "AOOS (out-of-sequence)" = "#FF8C00"
)

dri_dsri_complete <- timing_cohort %>%
  filter(!is.na(DRI), !is.na(DSRI))

n_dri_dsri_by_group <- dri_dsri_complete %>%
  count(seq_flag, name = "n_complete") %>%
  arrange(match(seq_flag, c("<50 sequence", "≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)")))

# Kruskal-Wallis tests (distribution differs by sequence group?)
kw_dri <- kruskal.test(DRI ~ seq_flag, data = dri_dsri_complete)
kw_dsri <- kruskal.test(DSRI ~ seq_flag, data = dri_dsri_complete)
format_p <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return("p < 0.001") else return(paste0("p = ", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3)))
}
p_lab_dri <- format_p(kw_dri$p.value)
p_lab_dsri <- format_p(kw_dsri$p.value)

# Panel A: DRI

  geom_density(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = sequence_colors_supp, name = "Sequence group") +
  labs(title = "A. Donor Risk Index (DRI)", x = "DRI", y = "Density") +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = 0.72, label = p_lab_dri,
           hjust = 1, size = 3.2) +
  theme_gastro(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",

# Panel B: DSRI

  geom_density(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 25)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sequence_colors_supp, name = "Sequence group") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sequence_colors_supp, name = "Sequence group") +
  labs(title = "B. Discard Risk Index (DSRI)", x = "DSRI", y = "Density") +
  annotate("text", x = 24, y = 0.195, label = p_lab_dsri,
           hjust = 1, size = 3.2) +
  theme_gastro(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0)
  )

  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Print N and Kruskal-Wallis (for supplement)

print(n_dri_dsri_by_group)
cat("\nTotal with complete DRI and DSRI:", sum(n_dri_dsri_by_group$n_complete), "\n")
```

**Supplemental Figure. DRI and DSRI distributions among accepted transplants by sequence group.** (A) Donor Risk Index (DRI). (B) Discard Risk Index (DSRI). Curves are density estimates for &lt;50 sequence, ≥50 sequence, and AOOS (out-of-sequence). Distributions were compared using the Kruskal–Wallis test; p-values are shown on each panel. N with complete DRI and DSRI used for this figure: &lt;50 sequence `r n_dri_dsri_by_group$n_complete[n_dri_dsri_by_group$seq_flag == "<50 sequence"]`, ≥50 sequence `r n_dri_dsri_by_group$n_complete[n_dri_dsri_by_group$seq_flag == "≥50 sequence"]`, AOOS `r n_dri_dsri_by_group$n_complete[n_dri_dsri_by_group$seq_flag == "AOOS (out-of-sequence)"]` (total `r sum(n_dri_dsri_by_group$n_complete)`).
